While simple by default, Daily You is packed with features: • Add photos, video, audio, and other attachments • Track your mood and see how it changes over time • Set random or scheduled reminders to stay consistent • Write rich notes with text formatting and Markdown support • Organize with a robust tag system to keep track of anything • Use advanced search tools and statistics to gain insights Daily You keeps your data safe: • No data is collected • Lock the app with a password • Encrypted backups and optional sync • Works fully offline; you control where your data lives Coming from another app? fdroid:adb.captain.name: ADB Captain
fdroid:adb.captain.summary: Run ADB commands on your phone. No root, no PC — via Shizuku.
fdroid:adb.captain.description:
ADB Captain runs ADB commands right on your phone. No computer, no root - it works through Shizuku.
What's inside:
- Terminal. pm, am, dumpsys, settings, input - anything adb shell takes. Several sessions at once, each with its own output and its own command still running. Autocomplete pulls from your command history, history is grouped by how recent it is, and you can pin the commands you use most.
- Debugging workspace. One tab for the job: a bug report ZIP, a timed session that records what you did and buffers the log while you reproduce a crash, saved macros for chains of commands, and crash logs grouped per app with the full stack trace.
- Apps. Every installed package in one list, user and system apps separated. Each one gets a plain safety rating, so you know what's safe to disable or remove. An inspector shows activities, services, receivers and providers with the permissions they need, and an intent launcher lets you build and fire an intent by hand.
- Processes. The real table with PID, parent, user and memory, searchable, with force-stop on any row.
- Devices. Model, Android version, battery, connection status. Reboot and screenshots from the same screen.
- Wireless ADB. Pair and connect to any device over Wi-Fi, then run shell commands on it. Saved devices, one-tap reconnect, optional auto-reconnect.
- Logcat. Live system log, filterable by level and text. Follow whatever app is in the front, save exactly what you see to a file, and share it as Markdown for a bug report.
- Sideload and tools. Install an APK from storage, record the screen, flip Wi-Fi, Bluetooth or airplane mode, type text, open links.
- Appearance. Material 3 Expressive, with light or dark theme, five accent palettes, or follow the system colors with Material You.
AGPL-3.0. No ads, no analytics, no accounts.

fdroid:in.hridayan.ashell.summary: Material Design 3 shell, ADB, and Fastboot utility for Android
fdroid:in.hridayan.ashell.description:
aShell You is an advanced shell and device management utility featuring a clean Material Design 3 interface. Execute ADB and shell commands on your local device or manage external devices via Wireless Debugging and USB OTG without requiring a PC.
 Key Features 
- Multi-Target Execution: Run commands locally via Shizuku or root, and remotely over Wi-Fi (pairing code/QR) or USB OTG.
- Fastboot OTG: Flash partitions, switch active slots (A/B), and execute bootloader operations over USB OTG.
- Screen Mirroring: Stream and interact with connected devices in real time with low-latency embedded scrcpy.
- Real-Time Logcat: Inspect system logs with tag search, regex filtering, and color-coded priority markers.
- ADB Sideload: Flash recovery update zip packages directly over USB OTG with live progress verification.
- Port Forwarding: Configure local and remote TCP port forwarding (adb forward/reverse) with active tunnel monitoring.
- Remote File Browser: Browse, push, pull, and manage files on connected targets.
- Command Examples & Bookmarks: Built-in catalog of common Android commands with custom bookmarking.
- Quick Settings Tiles: Launch custom shell scripts or toggle wireless debugging from the notification shade.
- Output Utilities: Continuous command streaming (top, logcat), text search, and text file export/sharing.
- Material Design 3: Dynamic colors, AMOLED dark theme, and interface scaling customization.
 Requirements 
- Local device execution requires Shizuku or root access (or local wireless debugging).
- Managing remote devices via OTG or Wi-Fi does not require root or Shizuku on the host device.
- Basic familiarity with ADB and shell commands is recommended.
 Translations

fdroid:io.github.strongsand.lshell.name: L-Shell Orbit
fdroid:io.github.strongsand.lshell.summary: Local monitoring and diagnostics for compatible Starlink equipment
fdroid:io.github.strongsand.lshell.description:
L-Shell Orbit is an independent, unofficial app for monitoring and diagnosing compatible Starlink terminals and routers over the local network.
Follow connection state, traffic, latency, packet loss, signal, power, obstruction and alerts using the data exposed by the equipment. Explore history and daily, weekly and monthly reports, export information, and manually back up and restore local data.
On compatible routers, also view reported PoE input voltage associated with the current terminal. This is not a measurement of current or cable-output voltage.
Arrange home screen cards, explore charts and follow metrics through widgets and notifications. Run normal and extreme speed tests or configure scheduled and smart tests. Android controls background execution and may delay these tests.
L-Shell Beacon is an optional collector that can retain Dishy history while the phone is away and synchronize it on the same network. Power Monitor displays electrical readings received from a compatible HTTP source; simulated data is labeled and never becomes a real measurement. Starlink monitoring works without an electrical sensor. Beacon features depend on compatible firmware.
The optional augmented-reality view uses public orbital data from CelesTrak. It shows predicted positions and does not confirm which satellite serves the terminal.
Core monitoring requires no Starlink account or Google Play Services. There are no ads, analytics or project cloud service. Telemetry and history stay on the device. Feature availability depends on hardware, firmware and network topology. The optional orbital catalog is downloaded over HTTPS; speed tests use the Internet connection.
Portuguese, English and Spanish text, widgets and AMOLED mode.
L-Shell Orbit is not affiliated with or endorsed by Starlink or SpaceX.

SweetKeyboard: Fast, Familiar, and Private Typing
SweetKeyboard is a local-first iOS keyboard that keeps numbers, symbols, cursor movement, and reusable clipboard snippets close to the typing flow without forcing users to learn an unfamiliar layout. Built for quick edits, codes, forms, and repeated snippets, it delivers a familiar typing experience with smarter everyday controls.
EVERYTHING YOU NEED IN ONE PLACE
• Numbers Stay Visible: The familiar English QWERTY letter layout features a permanent top number row from 1 to 0, reducing interruptions while you type codes, dates, and addresses.
• Symbols in One Place: Symbols are grouped on one clean page, designed to avoid deep symbol switching. Tap one symbol and return to letters, or lock symbols when you need to type multiple characters or emojis.
• Smarter Cursor Control: Move the cursor without fighting the iOS text magnifier using dedicated arrow keys or speed-aware horizontal swiping across the keyboard.
• Context-Aware Typing: SweetKeyboard adapts to the field you are typing in. For example, the keyboard shows a contextual @ shortcut in email fields and suppresses unwanted auto-capitalization.
• Long-Press Shortcuts: Hold supported keys for common accents and quick punctuation, keeping the main keyboard free of visual clutter.
• Fast Typing Stability: Designed for stable everyday typing, even when you move quickly and your fingers overlap.
• Forward Delete: Turn on forward delete, then use manual Shift to delete ahead of the cursor.
• Save and Reuse Snippets: Access a local clipboard grid inside the keyboard to save up to 50 local text snippets.
• Pin Favorites: Pin favorites so important snippets stay at the top of your list for quick, one-tap pasting.
• Native Clipboard Integration: Choose how SweetKeyboard handles text copied to the native iPhone Clipboard. You can import, paste, or do both after initiating a user action.
• Clear Text Field: Easily clear short fields directly from the compact keyboard toolbar.
CUSTOMIZABLE TO YOUR PREFERENCES
Your typing experience should fit your needs. Easily configure settings in the app, including optional haptic feedback for responsive keys, auto-capitalization rules, cursor swipe behaviors, and custom clipboard toolbar options.
PRIVATE BY DEFAULT, LOCAL BY DESIGN
Privacy is a central product value, not a secondary note.
• There are no analytics, no advertising SDKs, no tracking SDKs, and no cloud sync.
• SweetKeyboard features no remote text processing or keystroke uploading.
A NOTE ON CLIPBOARD FEATURES AND "FULL ACCESS"
To enable the optional clipboard features, iOS requires you to grant "Full Access". This simply gives the keyboard the necessary permissions to interact with the phone's native clipboard tools and shared local settings. This does not mean we have access to your data. Because SweetKeyboard is local by design with no cloud sync or remote processing, your typing, snippets, and clipboard history remain completely local to your device and are never compromised.
Platform Limitations: Some features depend on what the active app exposes to third-party keyboards. Secure text fields and certain apps may use the system keyboard instead. Clear Text Field works best in short fields and may be limited in long documents.

flathub:com.todoist.Todoist.name: Todoist
flathub:com.todoist.Todoist.description:
Simple yet powerful to do list, habit tracker & reminders. Organize work & life.
 Trusted by over 47 million people, Todoist simplifies tasks for individuals and teams. Instantly
 declutter your mind, boost productivity and use it as a habit tracker.
 With a simple click, add your daily tasks and set reminders, enjoy multiple views like calendar,
 list and board, filter tasks by work and/or personal life, share notes, collaborate on projects,
 and achieve peace of mind.
 Why choose Todoist?
 Todoist is a simple yet powerful planner tool that organizes both your life and work.
 As a habit tracker, you can add tasks like “Plan next week’s work every Friday afternoon”
 or “Do homework every Wednesday at 6pm” using Todoist’s powerful language recognition and recurring
 dates.
 Use it as a checklist to reach that mental clarity you’ve been longing for by capturing tasks
 at the speed of thought.
 View any project as a list, board or calendar to give you ultimate flexibility when planning
 both your tasks and your time.
 Available on any device – with apps, extensions, and widgets – Todoist is everywhere you
 need it to be.
 Link Todoist with your calendar, voice assistant, and 100+ other tools such as Outlook, Gmail,
 and Slack.
 Collaborate on projects of all sizes by assigning tasks to others. Have all your teamwork
 at hand by adding deadlines, notes, and files.
 Get up and running in no time with templates ranging from a schedule planner to packing lists,
 meeting agendas and more.
 Instantly see what’s most important by setting visual task priority levels.
 Work towards your goals with insights into your personalized productivity trends.
 Todoist on Linux
 Todoist is beautifully designed, simple to get started, and intuitive to use.
 Use the global quick add shortcut to capture ideas and tasks the moment they strike — even
 if you are in a different app.
 With natural language, write tasks like "tomorrow at 4pm" or “every other wednesday starting
 in two weeks” and Todoist will instantly parse it all out for you.
 Stay organized syncing across all other devices.

flathub:dev.geopjr.Archives.name: Archives
flathub:dev.geopjr.Archives.description:
Every day, countless of websites go offline for good. High server costs, government censorship,
 venture capitalism are some of the threats, many of your favorite websites are facing.
 Archives allows you to archive any website, including its assets, into a self-contained hybrid
 HTML/ZIP. These HTML files can be viewed in any browser (or in-app), be shared or be extracted
 like a regular ZIP file. Archives can additionally view WARC, WACZ, HAR, ZIM and SWF files.

flathub:eu.usdx.UltraStarDeluxe.name: UltraStar Deluxe
flathub:eu.usdx.UltraStarDeluxe.description:
UltraStar Deluxe is a free open source karaoke game for your PC. It records the voice of the
 players and gives points if they hit the notes. Unlike the commercial alternatives, UltraStar Deluxe

flathub:io.github.twanvl.MagicSetEditor2.name: MagicSetEditor
flathub:io.github.twanvl.MagicSetEditor2.summary: A program used to make custom cards
flathub:io.github.twanvl.MagicSetEditor2.description:
Magic Set Editor, or MSE for short, is a program with which you can design your own cards
 for popular trading card games. MSE can then generate images of those cards that you can print
 or upload to the internet. Magic Set Editor also has a statistics window that will give useful
 information about your set, like the average mana cost, number of rares, etc. When you have
 finished your set, you can export it to an HTML file to use on the Internet, or to Apprentice
 or CCG Lackey so you can play with your cards online.

flathub:io.sourceforge.clonekeenplus.name: Commander Genius
flathub:io.sourceforge.clonekeenplus.developer: Gerhard Stein, Elias Oenal, Pelya and Contributors
flathub:io.sourceforge.clonekeenplus.description:
Commander-Genius aka CloneKeenPlus is an engine which interprets
 Commander Keen 1-6, Dreams and Cosmos the Cosmic Adventure.
 But there is more: How about four player coop, VGA graphics, remastered music and
 many great mods to apply. There even exists the unoffical trilogy that was planned back then
 (Keen 7-9). Eventhough that trilogy was never released, it got picked up by fans. 
 With an integrated CG game store you can download every free game with one click and
 start playing.
 For registered Keen games you need the game data of the games
 in order to play them. Check the Readme file for more information on that.
 Episode 2, 3, 5 and 6 are registered versions which can be
 purchased by 3D Realms, Apogee, GOG or bought by someone else.
 If you still have the old games of the registered version,
 then copy those into a reachable directory and give it a try.

flathub:net.pcsx2.PCSX2.name: PCSX2
flathub:net.pcsx2.PCSX2.description:
PCSX2 is a free and open-source PlayStation 2 (PS2) emulator. Its purpose is to emulate the PS2's hardware, using a combination of MIPS CPU Interpreters, Recompilers, and a Virtual Machine which manages hardware states and PS2 system memory. This allows you to play PS2 games on your PC, with many additional features and benefits.
 PlayStation 2 and PS2 are registered trademarks of Sony Interactive Entertainment. This application is not affiliated in any way with Sony Interactive Entertainment.

flathub:net.sonic_pi.SonicPi.name: Sonic Pi
flathub:net.sonic_pi.SonicPi.description:

flathub:org.gnome.Genius.name: Genius
flathub:org.gnome.Genius.summary: Genius is a general purpose calculator program
flathub:org.gnome.Genius.description:
Genius is a general purpose calculator program similar in some aspects to BC, Matlab, Maple or Mathematica. 
 It is useful both as a simple calculator and as a research or educational tool. 
 The syntax is very intuitive and is designed to mimic how mathematics is usually written. 
 GEL is the name of its extension language, it stands for Genius Extension Language, clever isn't it? 
 In fact, many of the standard genius functions are written in GEL itself.
 What can it do?
 Arbitrary precision integers, multiple precision floats.
 Complex numbers, stored in Cartesian coordinates as usual.
 Math-like-looking expressions, tries to be as much a what-you-mean-is-what-Genius-understands, up to a limit of course.
 Matrix calculations / Linear Algebra, with many related functions.
 Number theory.
 Calculus, numerical and even very limited symbolic calculations.
 Statistics, all the basic statistical functions.
 Numerical equation solving, polynomial roots, etc...
 Combinatorics.
 Most common elementary / trigonometric functions.
 Modular arithmetic, including inversions and modular arithmetic on matrices.
 A complete programming language, with automatic typing. In fact large part of Genius standard library is written in GEL.
 2D Function line plots, standard 2D graphs of up to 10 functions at once, with possibility to export to EPS or PNG.
 Parametric plots, with possibility to export to EPS or PNG.
 3D Function surface plots, with possibility to export to EPS or PNG
 Slopefield/Vectorfield plotting.
 GUI IDE where you can edit and run/test your programs.
 Can output matrices in LaTeX, Troff (eqn) or MathML, this is I think a very cool feature that allows you to copy stuff directly from Genius to a document in LaTeX, troff or MathML.

flathub:org.kde.filelight.name: Filelight
flathub:org.kde.filelight.summary: Show disk usage and delete unused files
flathub:org.kde.filelight.description:
Filelight is an application to visualize the disk usage on your computer by showing folders
 using an easy-to-understand view of concentric rings. Filelight makes it simple to free up space!
 Features:
 Scan local, remote, or removable disks
 View detailed information about files and folders
 Delete files or folders that are taking up too much space
 Integration into the Dolphin, Konqueror, and Krusader file managers
 Configurable color schemes

flathub:org.kde.kalgebra.name: KAlgebra
flathub:org.kde.kalgebra.description:
KAlgebra is an application that can replace your graphing calculator. It has numerical, logical,
 symbolic, and analysis features that let you calculate mathematical expressions on the console
 and graphically plot the results in 2D or 3D. KAlgebra is rooted in the Mathematical Markup Language
 (MathML); however, one does not need to know MathML to use KAlgebra.

flathub:org.kde.yakuake.name: Yakuake
flathub:org.kde.yakuake.description:
Yakuake is a drop-down terminal emulator based on KDE Konsole technology.

 Smoothly rolls down from the top of your screen
 Tabbed interface
 Configurable dimensions and animation speed

 Sophisticated D-Bus interface

flathub:org.mediaharbor.MediaHarbor.name: MediaHarbor
flathub:org.mediaharbor.MediaHarbor.description:
MediaHarbor is a cross-platform music downloader and player. It connects to Spotify,
 Tidal, Qobuz, Deezer, Apple Music, and more, letting you download
 tracks at their native source quality and play them from a local library.
 Features include:
 High-quality audio downloads from major streaming services
 Built-in player with shuffle, repeat, crossfade, and visualizer
 Lyrics display with word-level and line-level sync
 Automatic metadata tagging and cover art embedding
 Local library management with file watching

fedora-packages:aspell/aspell.name: aspell
fedora-packages:aspell/aspell.description: GNU Aspell is a spell checker designed to eventually replace Ispell. It can either be used as a library or as an independent spell checker. Its main feature is that it does a much better job of coming up with possible suggestions than just about any other spell checker out there for the English language, including Ispell and Microsoft Word. It also has many other technical enhancements over Ispell such as using shared memory for dictionaries and intelligently handling personal dictionaries when more than one Aspell process is open at once.

fedora-packages:CalcMySky/CalcMySky.description: CalcMySky is a software package that simulates scattering of light by the atmosphere to render daytime and twilight skies (without stars). Its primary purpose is to enable realistic view of the sky in applications such as planetaria. Secondary objective is to make it possible to explore atmospheric effects such as glories, fogbows etc., as well as simulate unusual environments such as on Mars or an exoplanet orbiting a star with a non-solar spectrum of radiation.

fedora-packages:engauge-digitizer/engaug.name: engauge-digitizer-samples
fedora-packages:engauge-digitizer/engaug.description: This package contains several sample image files that may be imported into Engauge Digitizer (http://digitizer.sourceforge.net). These files are listed below, with comments: - corners.png - Graph that lots of corners that would be painful to digitize manually - gridlines.gif - Graph with gridlines that are easily removed by Engauge - gridlines_log.gif - Another graph with gridlines that are easily removed by Engauge - gridlines_log.src - Creates gridlines_log.gif in gnuplot using 'load' command (not an image!) - inverse.jpg - Image of y/x function - inverse.png - Same as inverse.jpg but in png format - linlog.jpg - Graph with linear/logarithmic coordinates - linlog.png - Same as linlog.jpg but in png format - loglin.png - Graph with logarithmic/linear coordinates - loglog.png - Graph with logarithmic/logarithmic coordinates - normdist.jpg - Graph of normal distribution - normdist.png - Same as normdist.jpg but in png format - pointmatch.jpg - Graph with fuzzy points for playing with Point Match feature of Engauge - pointplot.bmp - Graph with points that are easily captured by Point Match feature of Engauge, if the Discretize settings are set to "Intensity 90 to 99" for the triangles, and "Intensity 10 to 50" for the diamonds - polarcircles.jpg - Polar plot for experimenting. No coordinates are displayed, so not very useful - polarplot.jpg - Polar plot with cardioid pattern - polarplot.png - Same as polarplot.jpg but in png format - testcase.jpg - Simple graph that serves as an excellent starting point for the new user - testcase.png - Same as testcase.jpg but in png format - testcoords.jpg - Advanced graph used by developers to check the affine transformations in Engauge - testcoords.sxd - Open Office document used to create testcoords.jpg (not an image!) - usgs.png - Fictional map loosely based on U.S. Geological Survey topographic maps

They run the action and potentially retry running it with some configurable delay for a configurable number of times. firefox-addons:3089044.name: ITGlue Password Manager
firefox-addons:3089044.description:
A simple browser extension that can be used in combination with your own ITGlue environment.
Just install the add-on, once it open it will ask for Masterpassword and your ITGlue API-Key.
The API-Key must be configured by the ITGlue admin and must have "password access" enabled.
The data will be cached on your device for 10 minutes and than will be purged.
In the settings within the add-on is an option to reset your Masterpassword and setup an extension lock after 10 minutes or on browser close.
There is no need for an account within this extension. if you lost your Masterpassword, simply remove the extension and re-add to setup a new password. Remember to keep your API-Key available.
This extension uses only the get functionality of the ITGlue api and will not store or save any data on your device other then a 10 minute cache to make the extension a bit quicker with loading data.
The API-Key will be stored local but will be encrypted the moment you create the Masterpassword.
This add-on will always be free, bug reports or feature requests can be send to development@dyca-computers.nl

bluejetty:00074219:ios.description:
Turn speech into text, transcribe recordings, and translate conversations with Voice to Text - Dictate Speech.
Voice to Text - Dictate Speech helps you capture spoken ideas wherever they happen. Dictate notes, record meetings, transcribe lectures, convert audio or video into text, and translate speech or written text in one focused app. Whether you are writing hands-free, reviewing an interview, preparing meeting minutes, or saving class notes, it keeps your voice, recordings, and transcripts easy to work with.
Voice Dictation
• Dictate text in real time instead of typing
• Create notes, messages, journal entries, drafts, and longer documents
• Configure three independent language zones for multilingual work
• Supports more than 40 dictation languages
AI Transcription
• Transcribe voice memos, audio files, recordings, videos, and YouTube links
• Convert meetings, interviews, lectures, classes, podcasts, and conversations into editable text
• Use AI speech recognition for fast, high-quality transcripts
• Supports over 100 transcription languages
Translation
• Translate spoken or written text into more than 40 languages
• Dictate in one language and work with the result in another
• Share translated text with other apps in just a few taps
Files, Export, and Sync
• Save audio and text files with the Apple Files app
• Export dictations and transcripts as text files or PDFs
• Organize recordings, notes, and transcripts for later use
• Sync across iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple Watch with iCloud
Designed for Everyday Productivity
• Record and replay dictations
• Share text through Mail, Messages, WhatsApp, Facebook, X, and more
• Use Apple Shortcuts to speed up repeated workflows
• Improve recognition with a custom user dictionary
• Undo text edits when you need to revise quickly
• Back up your data with built-in backup tools
Accessibility and Comfort
• Compatible with VoiceOver
• Adjustable text sizes for better readability
• Customizable button layout for easier use
• Optional dictation privacy mode, depending on device capabilities
Voice to Text - Dictate Speech is built for students, writers, journalists, professionals, travelers, and anyone who wants to capture speech, audio, meetings, notes, and ideas without typing everything by hand.
Important Notes Concerning Subscriptions of Dictation - Voice to Text

bluejetty:00060705:ios.description:
AR Reading List is the fast, simple way to find Accelerated Reader books and track reading progress — whether you're a student hunting for your next quiz, a parent guiding your kid's reading list, or a teacher pulling together a classroom shelf.
SCAN A BARCODE, GET INSTANT QUIZ INFO
Point your camera at any book's ISBN barcode to instantly see its AR quiz number, point value, reading level, and word count. No typing, no searching through long lists.
POWERFUL SEARCH THAT FITS HOW YOU THINK
Search by title keywords, author name, reading level range, points, or award collection — or combine any of them. Looking for a 3.5 to 4.2 level book worth 5 or more points? Done. Want to browse Newbery Medal winners at a specific level? Done.
Award collections included:
• Newbery Medal and Honor books
• Caldecott Medal and Honor books
• Coretta Scott King Award and Honors
• ALA Notable and Best Books
BUILD YOUR PERSONAL READING LIST
Save any book to your list with one tap. Mark books as Unread, Reading, or Read to see your progress at a glance. Filter your list by status to pick what's next.
HABITS THAT STICK
• Set a monthly reading goal and track how you're doing
• Build a reading streak with optional daily reminders
• Unlock achievements as you hit milestones
• Revisit every book from your search history
EVERYTHING YOU NEED ON ONE BOOK PAGE
Title, author, series, reading level, points, word count, interest level, topic, and summary — all in one clean view. Plus quick links to Amazon, Google, Goodreads, and archive.org to learn more or read online.
FREE, WITH AN AD-FREE UPGRADE AVAILABLE
Everything is free to use. Upgrade anytime to remove ads.
Whether you're prepping for a quiz, curating a classroom library, or just keeping track of what the kids are reading, AR Reading List has you covered.
Questions or feedback? Email arlistsupprt@gmail.com or visit www.arlst.com.
AR Reading List is not affiliated with or endorsed by Renaissance Learning, Inc. "Accelerated Reader," "AR," "Renaissance Learning," "Newbery," and "Caldecott" are trademarks of their respective owners.

bluejetty:00086798:ios.name: SMA Energy
bluejetty:00086798:ios.summary: Thanks to the SMA Energy app, you can see all the most important data relating to your SMA Energy System in a clearly structured format. You can intelligently manage energy flows in your household or charge your electric vehicle – sustainab
bluejetty:00086798:ios.description:
Thanks to the SMA Energy app, you can see all the most important data relating to your SMA Energy System in a clearly structured format. You can intelligently manage energy flows in your household or charge your electric vehicle – sustainably with your own solar power or at high speed if you’re in a hurry. Thanks to the SMA Energy app, you can have your own personal energy transition in your pocket.
* Energy system at a glance, wherever you are * 
In the visualization area, you can find all the most important energy and power data for your SMA Energy System. Whether daily, weekly, monthly or yearly, you can see exactly how much electricity your PV system produces, what it was used for and how much grid-supplied power you have remaining. This enables you to keep constant track of your energy budget.
* Optimizing and managing energy flows * 
In the optimization area, you can view current forecasts for solar power production. The app shows you how to use your energy even more sustainably. For example, you can automatically utilize your own, self-generated solar power as efficiently as possible for your own needs and reduce your grid-supplied power.
* Charging electric vehicles * 
Do you drive an electric vehicle and want to refuel it with your own solar power using the SMA EV Charger charging solution? In the e-mobility area, you can control your car’s charging process easily and efficiently. You can choose between two charging modes: Forecast-based charging enables charging at minimal cost and with the peace of mind that your vehicle will be ready to go when you need it by configuring a charging target; optimized charging means intelligent charging of the vehicle with self-generated solar power.
Thanks to the SMA Energy app, you can use your self-generated solar power from your SMA Energy System in a highly sustainable manner and optimize your energy budget. The app is your perfect companion for the energy transition at home and the mobility transition on the road.

bluejetty:00073939:ios.description:
Need to know what the marine forecast is before you go boating or during your boating trip? The Boating Weather App for iPhone and iPod Touch is the answer.
This intuitive app will show you the wind speed, surf and wave height for your coastal zone in the United States. Marine weather data is provided by the National Weather Service (NOAA).
Features:
- One touch National Weather Service forecast for today, tonight and this week.
- Shows wind speed, seas wave height and surf forecast.
- Add a location to Favorites for easy reference when switching between zones
- Shows small craft advisories.
- Set your default location to show your local boat weather forecast.
- Simple, intuitive design, quick loading
Whether you want to go on a boating trip, out fishing or for a quick sail, the Boating Weather iPhone App will tell you in a snap what the seas are doing!
Thank you for choosing our marine weather application. We understand that some users have encountered issues due to recent changes in the NOAA API endpoint. Our team has worked diligently to resolve these issues and has updated the application accordingly.

bluejetty:00060734:ios.summary: Reimagining the Examen offers a unique prayer experience that’s tailored to your needs and mood. Each Examen, based on St. Ignatius’s 500-year-old prayer, guides you through a stimulating reflection on your day, helping you invite God into
bluejetty:00060734:ios.description:
Reimagining the Examen offers a unique prayer experience that’s tailored to your needs and mood. Each Examen, based on St. Ignatius’s 500-year-old prayer, guides you through a stimulating reflection on your day, helping you invite God into your nitty-gritty. Choose an Examen that matches your current state of being, or pray that day’s scheduled reflection.
Reimagining the Examen, created by Loyola Press, is based on Mark Thibodeaux, SJ’s best-selling book, “Reimagining the Ignatian Examen,” which offers flexible and adaptable versions of the Examen. Begin the app experience today to invite grace, gratitude, and insight into your daily life.
What is the Examen? 
St. Ignatius of Loyola created the Examen to be a very short prayer that can be prayed at any time. In the Examen, we review our recent past to find God and his blessings in our daily life. Ignatius would say that the Examen should be the most important moment of our day, because this moment affects every other moment.
How Do I Pray the Examen?
There are five simple steps to the Examen, which this app leads you through:
1. Relish the moments that went well and all of the gifts you have today.
2. Request that the Spirit lead you through your review of the day.
3. Review your day.
4. Repent of any mistakes or failures.
5. Resolve, in concrete ways, to live tomorrow well.

bluejetty:00017470:ios.name: WWE SuperCard - Wrestling Game
bluejetty:00017470:ios.summary: WWE SuperCard is the collectible card game made for wrestling fans by wrestling fans. A deck-building game where strategy decides the match, not luck. Collect your favorite Superstar cards, build a deck that fits your play style and go head
bluejetty:00017470:ios.description:
WWE SuperCard is the collectible card game made for wrestling fans by wrestling fans. A deck-building game where strategy decides the match, not luck. Collect your favorite Superstar cards, build a deck that fits your play style and go head-to-head with real players. 
NEW IN SEASON 13
• Off the Ropes: a new always-on mode that's easy to pick up, hard to put down. Convert your cards into ammo and smash through a wall of blocks to rack up rewards. 
• Four new rarities to chase: Echelon, Core, Tear and Horde. Themed card sets all season long: eras, factions, tag teams, rivalries and PLEs, each with its own bonus.
• Alts: rare cards with a shiny finish, the ultimate showstopper.
• Better collection experience: every card you own in one place, with rewards for completing Super Sets. More room for your cards, so you can rip, collect and repeat.
• Card customization: add stickers and backplates to your Season 13 cards and make them yours.
• Easier upgrades: combining cards now keeps your progress, and Bulk Combine clears your binder in a few taps. 
BUILD YOUR WRESTLING UNIVERSE 
Today's WWE Superstars and the Legends who built wrestling, all in one place Cody Rhodes, Roman Reigns, Oba Femi, CM Punk, Seth Rollins, Rhea Ripley, Charlotte Flair, Becky Lynch, Jacob Fatu, Stephanie Vaquer, Bron Breakker, Drew McIntyre, Penta, Mr. Iguana, Iyo Sky, Tiffany Stratton, John Cena, The Undertaker, "Stone Cold" Steve Austin, Shawn Michaels, Triple H, Kurt Angle, Eddie Guerrero, Rey Mysterio, Trish Stratus, Batista and hundreds more. The card art carries its own weight too: bold, constantly refreshed designs, plenty of them animated.
EVERY EVENT, IN YOUR DECK
SuperCard moves in step with WWE. New Superstar cards, modes and events drop on a steady rhythm, built around RAW, SmackDown, NXT, AAA and every Premium Live Event: Royal Rumble, Elimination Chamber, WrestleMania, King of the Ring, Money in the Bank, SummerSlam, Survivor Series and more. 
A GAME MODE FOR EVERY OCCASION
• Enjoy a full lineup of single-player modes from quick hits like Off the Ropes and BOOM! to the Super ShowDown draft.
• Go head-to-head with real players in Leagues, the live PvP mode for CCG competitors.
• Run with a crew in co-op modes like Team Battleground and Tag Team Takedown, compete in Team events and rep an active community of WWE fans.
• Climb the leaderboard in Road to Immortality, the campaign mode that takes you from independent bouts to international renown.
• Play mini-games on the go and come back every day to keep your streak up and earn bigger bonuses.
WWE SuperCard is free to download and includes optional in-game purchases, including paid random items. Drop-rate details for random item purchases are available in-game. In-app purchases can be turned off in your device's Settings.
To delete your account and associated data, visit: https://cdgad.cdgsrv.com/wwe
Do Not Sell My Personal Information: https://www.take2games.com/ccpa

bluejetty:00068018:ios.description:
Pixelwoods is a charming coloring game from Beresnev. It features hundreds of signature Color By Number pictures, an old mansion in need of makeover and new design, cute pixel art, and a captivating story!
Ellie's parents disappeared when she was very young. Now the aspiring artist returns home to solve the mystery of their disappearance, restore the old house, and learn about the special magic of Pixelwoods...
This cozy forest world and its funny characters will appeal both to fans of mysteries and puzzle games, and to those who appreciate homey comfort and good comedy humor. Talking animals, smart plants, a machine for interdimensional travels coexist here with home design talks, a love triangle and, of course, coloring by numbers!
We offer:
- Easy and relaxing paint by numbers gameplay: making art here in Pixelwoods is easy and pleasant. Your inner artist will be happy to have a chance to express himself!
- Unique pixel graphics and visual style: cozy, unusual, fascinating. Pixelwoods makes you want to come back time and time again to explore this little world.
- A fascinating plot with elements of mysticism, detective and comedy: this art game knows how to tell a story!
- Cozy atmosphere and touching characters: drawn in a cute chibi-style, they will soon become your friends. The logical Ellie, the naive and romantic Sean, the strange but lovable Luke-the-hermit... Come and meet them!
- Dozens of coloring books for you to fill with hundreds of paintings: all hand-crafted by professional artists.
- A variety of room and garden makeover options: to decorate one’s home has never been more pleasant! Choose from furniture, wallpaper, appliances, and even materials.
...and much more!
Help Ellie settle into her new place, make friends, recognize enemies, and find out WHAT really happened to her parents! 
Welcome to Pixelwoods, a gorgeous 3 in 1: it’s a **makeover game**, a **painting game** and **puzzle game** at the same time!
Check it out!

bluejetty:00015540:ios.description:
Learn how to play your favorite songs on the piano! OnlinePianist is perfect for pianists who want to learn to play the piano to songs they love. Download today to have access to thousands of popular songs and classical pieces that are updated regularly!
Just open the app to access piano tutorials! Select 3 songs to begin, choose one of those songs, hit “play full song” and learn away! Your piano tutorial will appear, showing the keyboard helper to show you how the song goes! Follow along as the falling colors appear to show you what keys to hit for both your left and right hand! 
Equipped with 13 unique virtual piano learning features that give you a personalized learning experience! Dependent on your preferences, you can customize your individual hand practice, adjust the speed, choose from beginner and pro versions of every song, step-by-step free piano lessons, and more!
Choose to learn from thousands of songs, from classic to modern, and add it to your personal songbook! Collect and practice your favorites and learn how to play piano!
Download the OnlinePianist app today and learn how to play your favorites and the classics - from beginner to pro level! 
ONLINEPIANIST FEATURES:
VIRTUAL PIANO LESSONS
• Improve piano best practices with virtual piano tutorials
• Learn to play piano with falling colors that appear to show you what keys to hit
• Play piano in segments - intro, verse, chorus, and outro
CUSTOMIZABLE FEATURES
• Play piano with individual hand practice before merging 
• Adjust the speed on piano tutorials to help with learning
• Receive finger picking (positions) advice as you play
MANY SONGS TO CHOOSE FROM
• Choose from beginner or pro versions of each song
• Thousands of popular songs and classical pieces to learn to play on piano!
PERSONAL SONGBOOK
• Collect and practice your favorite songs on piano!
• Sync your piano lessons in real time
• Step-by-step free piano lessons
Download OnlinePianist now to learn how to play your favorite songs on piano!

How the subscription works:
• OnlinePianist is an auto-renewing subscription service
• Subscriptions are annual ($59.99), six months($41.99) or three months($29.99).
• Every subscription period includes access to all player features and songs.
• Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
• Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
• The account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal.
• Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase.
• Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
• Visit our Terms of Use & Privacy Policy for more information.
• Private Policy: https://www.onlinepianist.com/legal/privacy
• Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.onlinepianist.com/legal/eula
• Terms of Service: https://www.onlinepianist.com/legal/terms

bluejetty:00044957:ios.description:
Cenlar Mobile™ 
Manage your mortgage on the go.
Description and benefits:
Cenlar Mobile™ , a convenient and secure way to manage your home loan right from your phone. Easily make a payment, check account balance, see when taxes were paid, view a statement or sign up for automatic payments. The new app has functionality similar to the website. Use our calculators to determine how to save interest and pay off your mortgage sooner. 
What you can do on Cenlar Mobile™ :
• Stay current on your mortgage details and outstanding balance 
• Make a payment and view payment status 
• Enroll in AutoPay and view scheduled payments on your mortgage
• Calculate changes to PMI based on projected changes to your loan
• View details on escrow, taxes and insurance
• Calculate the impact of making additional payments on interest cost savings and earlier loan pay off 
• View the Learning Center to see frequently asked topics and questions
How to access:
• Complete the secure registration on Cenlar Mobile™ if you have not previously registered on our app or website
• Use thumbprint or facial recognition for subsequent login
We are listening and will continue to make improvements. Here’s What’s New – 
o Redesigned and more intuitive user experience
o Enhancements to the Payment History screen to display reversed payments
o Enhanced messaging for when the app is down for maintenance 
o Ability to display full loan number
o Ability to submit a secure message with one attachment (PDF, PNG, JPEG)
Please note you will need [iOS version 13.0] or greater.

bluejetty:00028750:ios.description:
Do you play games and need an easy way to keep score?
Are you tired of using pen and paper?
Do your kids keep asking, “Who is winning?”
Score Keeper is a simple, colorful, and fun way to track points for any game — at home, at school, or with friends.
Perfect for board games, family competitions, classroom activities, sports, and everyday challenges.
Why Choose Score Keeper?
● Clean and simple interface
● No ads — no distractions
● Large, easy-to-read fonts
● Fun and colorful score display
● Designed for both adults and kids
Key Features
● Create unlimited scoreboards
● Set custom names for your scoreboards
● Add multiple teams
● Assign colors to each team
● Choose your own score increment
● Large fonts for clear visibility
● Completely ad-free experience
— — —
How does Score Keeper work?
Simply create a scoreboard, add team names, and start adding or subtracting points. The score updates instantly and is displayed clearly for everyone to see.
Can I create multiple scoreboards?
Yes. You can create as many scoreboards as you like — perfect for different games or events.
Can I customize team names and colors?
Yes. You can name each team and assign a unique color to make scores easy to follow.
Is the app suitable for kids?
Absolutely. The large fonts and colorful layout make it easy for kids to understand who is winning.
Does the app contain ads?
No. The app is completely ad-free for a distraction-free experience.
Is the app free?
The app is free to download and use, with optional premium features available via in-app purchase.
— — —
If you enjoy the app, please leave a review on the App Store. Your feedback really helps.
Questions or suggestions? We’d love to hear from you.

bluejetty:00091080:ios.description:
Inspire curiosity and a love of reading with Curioso. Kids on Curioso can read and learn anytime, anywhere with unlimited access to 25,000 high-quality books, plus quizzes, trivia, badges and more to keep learning fun.
Designed for kids ages 2-14, Curioso makes it easy for kids to read for fun, and read to learn. With picture books, chapter books, early readers, read-along books, phonics books, graphic novels, and the world’s leading nonfiction digital library for kids, Curioso supports their growth and ignites their passion for learning.
GROW READING SKILLS
Emerging readers develop literacy skills with thousands of phonics books, decodables, early readers and leveled books. Word highlighting and a built-in dictionary help build fluency and language skills. Enjoy storytime together with thousands of picture books, or your child can enjoy Curioso independently with readalong audio.
FALL IN LOVE WITH READING
Research shows kids are more likely to develop a love of reading when they choose their own books. Curioso provides instant access to 25,000 digital books - an entire library at their fingertips. Snuggle up with a beloved picture book, read all about space, test your knowledge with animal trivia, lose track of time in a novel and more. Curioso grows with your child and recommendations are personalized to your child’s age, reading level and interests for endless exploration and growth.
IGNITE A LOVE OF LEARNING
Dive in, explore and learn something new. From shapes and counting to fascinating facts about whales or ancient history, your Curioso subscription includes instant access to the world’s largest non-fiction digital library for kids. Kids can explore interests and passions like:
Science, Space, Animals and Pets, Dinosaurs, Drawing, Crafts,
Origami, Math, History, Biographies, Sports, Cooking, Trivia and more!
INTERACTIVE FEATURES MAKE LEARNING FUN
Kids can test their knowledge with fun quizzes and trivia, plus earn badges and rewards to keep them motivated. Interactive Discovery Zones let kids dive deep into their favorite topics.
ASK CURIOSO
With Ask Curioso™, our exclusive kids' AI resource, kids can ask factual questions and get factual answers in return. Why is the sky blue? Who was Alexander Hamilton? Answers are only from the vetted, age-appropriate books in our library, with sources provided, so they can click through to read mo

bluejetty:00035497:ios.description:
Step into the action-packed world of Ragdoll Hit, the ultimate stickman fight game! Prepare yourself for thrilling action battles with realistic ragdoll physics that make every hit, slash, and smash incredibly satisfying. This game offers endless action and challenges for all fans of action games.
Choose from a vast array of weapons to fight through challenging levels and beat the boss in extreme action battles. Whether you prefer swords, hammers, or other weapons, Ragdoll Hit has something for every action hero. The many fun levels will keep you engaged for hours.
Experience the excitement of fun physics-based gameplay that ensures every fight feels dynamic and unique. The ragdoll mechanics add a layer of unpredictability and excitement, making each encounter different from the last. Get ready to engage in some intense stickman fight action that will test your skills and reflexes.
Features:
- Lots of weapons to choose from
- Many fun levels
- Fun physics-based gameplay
- Extreme boss fights
- Awesome skins for your hero
Ragdoll Hit is perfect for fans of stickman games and fighting games. Enjoy the unique ragdoll mechanics as you battle against supreme fighters. Whether you are looking to beat the boss or simply enjoy some action-packed gameplay, Ragdoll Hit delivers on all fronts.
Join the ranks of supreme fighters and take on the toughest opponents. This game combines the best elements of stickman games and ragdoll games to create an unforgettable action gaming experience. Become a hero in the fight game that everyone is talking about.
Get ready to beat the boss and rise to the top in Ragdoll Hit. The action never stops, and the excitement is always high. Start your journey in one of the best action games available. Fight your way through many fun levels, customize your hero with awesome skins, and prove yourself in extreme boss fights. This is the ultimate action game for all stickman and fighting game fans.
Feel the thrill of combat and the satisfaction of victory. Ragdoll Hit is not just a game; it’s an action-packed adventure that will keep you on the edge of your seat. Equip your hero, choose your weapons, and dive into the fun physics-based gameplay that makes every fight an epic showdown. Experience the best in action gaming!

bluejetty:00080950:ios.description:
Are you a coin collector looking to unlock a world of knowledge about your latest find? Are you a beginner and wish to become a coin collector? 
Or are you simply someone who accidentally sees a coin and wants to know its value and national origin? Yes, it's all here! Introducing the Coin Identifier Scanner app - your one-stop shop for all things coin-related!
How it works:
With just a direct photo of the coin or selected from the photo library, our app can accurately identify your coin, providing detailed information about name, country, material, history its and estimate the coin's value. You will no longer have to sift through countless coin catalogs or spend hours searching for information on websites. Our app - the ultimate tool that makes coin collecting easy and fun.
Key Features:
• Easy-to-use interface
• Fast and accurate coin recognition
• Estimate the price of identified coins
• Extensive information about coins from all around the world
• Identify rare coins
• Ability to create multiple collections of coins
• Access statistics on the total value of all coins and countries
• Interesting facts about coins
• Stay updated on popular coin collection series
Coin Identifier Scanner is the perfect app for coin enthusiasts of all levels. From beginners to experienced researchers and numismatists, Coin Identifier Scanner is for everyone. What are you waiting for? Download now and unlock all features. Coin Identifiers: CoinIn Scan will be beside your exciting journey.
Please note that terms and conditions, as well as our privacy policy, apply.
Terms of Use: https://sites.google.com/view/coin-identifier-scan-terms
Privacy Policy: https://sites.google.com/view/coin-identifier-scan-policy
For any questions or suggestions on how we can improve the app, please contact us.
Contact us: coinidentifier.support@gmail.com.

bluejetty:00084616:ios.description:
Record your screen in Full HD—then edit and share in minutes.
Capture gameplay, Facecam reactions, tutorials, meetings, and more.
Everything you need to record and create, all in one app.
Super Screen Recorder turns your iPhone or iPad into a complete screen recording studio. Capture smooth, high-quality video, add Facecam or voice commentary, and polish your recording with an easy-to-use video editor.
Whether you’re sharing an epic game, explaining an app, creating a reaction video, or recording a presentation, you can do it all without switching between multiple apps.
## RECORD IN HIGH QUALITY
Create clear screen recordings with settings that match your needs.
• Record your screen in Full HD
• Customize resolution, frame rate, and bit rate
• Record in portrait or landscape mode
• Capture longer sessions without a preset time limit
• Set a timer to stop recording automatically
• Broadcast your screen live with supported services
From quick clips to longer gameplay and tutorials, Super Screen Recorder gives you the flexibility to capture every important moment.
## ADD FACECAM & YOUR VOICE
Make your screen recordings more personal and engaging.
Turn on the front-facing camera to add Facecam to your gameplay, tutorial, or reaction video. Capture your commentary while recording, or add narration and a voiceover afterward.
Facecam is perfect for:
• Gameplay reactions and commentary
• Reaction videos
• App reviews and walkthroughs
• Lessons and how-to videos
• Product demos and presentations
## EDIT YOUR VIDEO IN ONE APP
Your recording is only the beginning. Use the built-in video editor to create a polished video that’s ready to share.
• Trim and cut unwanted moments
• Crop the frame and change the aspect ratio
• Add music, narration and voiceovers
• Rotate your video
• Compress videos for easier sharing
• Apply fun voice effects
• Turn videos into animated GIFs
• Turn videos into audio
The intuitive video editor makes it easy to clean up a screen recording, highlight the best moments, and create content that looks and sounds better.
## CREATE FOR ANY OCCASION
Super Screen Recorder is built for gamers, creators, students, teachers, and professionals.
Use it to record:
• Mobile games and highlights
• Tutorials and step-by-step guides
• Facecam and reaction videos
• Online meetings and presentations
• App demonstrations
• Training and educational content
• Video feedback and bug reports
• Short clips and GIFs
## ADD YOUR OWN WATERMARK
Personalize your content with a custom watermark. Add your logo, trademark, or brand to make your videos recognizable when you share them online.
RECORD. EDIT. SHARE.
No complicated setup. No need for multiple editing apps.
Capture your screen, add Facecam or commentary, edit your video, and export the finished recording—all with Super Screen Recorder.
Download Super Screen Recorder and start creating today.
*Maximum recording length depends on available device storage and system conditions.
Questions, feedback, or suggestions? Contact us at: superscreenrecorder@outlook.com
AUTO-RENEWABLE SUBSCRIPTION TERMS
Super Screen Recorder offers monthly and yearly subscription plans.
Payment will be charged to your Apple Account when you confirm your purchase. Your subscription automatically renews unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period.
You can manage or cancel your subscription in your Apple Account settings.

bluejetty:00090235:ios.description:
LivingInsider is an innovative real estate marketplace platform designed to facilitate property transactions. We provide comprehensive solutions for buying, selling, and renting real estate, ensuring convenience and efficiency for all stakeholders. Whether you are a buyer, seller, investor, or agent, our platform is tailored to meet your diverse housing and investment needs.
• Search for homes, condos, and all types of real estate : Easily and quickly search for property listings for sale or rent. Utilize specific filters such as location, price, or project to narrow down your search.
• Post real estate listings without any limits: Supports both property owners and agents.
• Advanced sales tools: Promote your listings to reach your target audience and chat with potential customers instantly.
• Real estate news and articles: Stay updated on investment trends and receive expert advice to guide your decisions
These are our key features that make real estate transactions easier, as follows:
 - Intelligent Search: A smart search system designed to cater to every lifestyle, saving time and enhancing search accuracy. No matter what keywords you use or how complex your criteria are, the system ensures you quickly find the property you’re looking for.
 - Filter : A powerful tool to streamline and enhance property searches, making them more intuitive and personalized. Users can apply specific criteria to discover listings that perfectly align with their needs.
- Inquiry: Enables effortless communication between buyers, tenants, and property owners, offering a convenient, fast, and reliable way to ensure no opportunity is missed.
- My Stock : A tool for property owners, agents, and investors to manage their assets more easily, all in one place.
 - iStock : The largest property hub in Thailand for professional real estate agents, with real-time alerts for what you're searching for.
- Notify Me: A premium feature delivering smart, real-time alerts to keep you ahead of the curve. It ensures you’re the first to know about top-tier properties across all categories, tailored to your preferences.
- Looking : A feature that allows buyers and renters to directly communicate their property needs to owners or agents, eliminating the need for time-consuming searches.
 -Chat : Complete deals, all in chat. Supported in Chinese, English, and Thai languages.
About LivingInsider, we are a leading real estate marketplace website. Currently, Livinginsider.com ranks among the top websites in Thailand, with over 4,000,000 monthly active users. Our platform allows users to post listings for the sale and rental of condos and houses. We offer comprehensive listings for residential rentals in Bangkok and across all regions of Thailand, Whether it's renting a house, leasing a condo unit, or listing for tenants, selling, and finding customers , and connections. It is the ultimate platform for real estate transactions, connecting buyers, sellers, and renters.
In addition, Livinginsider.com updates real estate articles and news daily, including property reviews and condo reviews in popular locations, to help users find the best options. We also provide investment insights to help individuals gain comprehensive knowledge about real estate.
We believe that our efforts contribute to enhancing the quality of people's lives, and we remain steadfast in our commitment to providing the highest quality products and services to all of our users
For additional inquiries or quicker responses, Our customer support team is available 24/7 to assist you. You may add us on Line at @Livinginsider or click this link to connect with us via Line.

bluejetty:00090632:ios.description:
Welcome to FastFocus: The Simple Fasting Tracker for Your Health Goals!
FastFocus is probably the best fasting app to keep you on track and help you focus on reaching your fitness and health goals. Whether you practice intermittent fasting for weight loss or are looking to improve your overall health, FastFocus will offer a clean and simple experience for tracking fasting, planning goals, and monitoring progress.
WHY FASTING?
√ Achieve weight loss and stay fit with the most natural diet tracker.
√ Burn body fat reserves while boosting your fitness and energy levels.
√ Enjoy the benefits of fasting without needing restrictive diets or intensive workouts.
√ Boost your growth hormone naturally to enhance fat burning and recovery.
√ Improve your overall body health and optimize brain function.
√ Avoid calorie counting—just focus on a simple fasting routine with tools like a fasting timer.
Fasting with FastFocus is a great way to simplify your life, lose weight, and live healthier. It’s the ultimate fasting tracker, offering everything you need for intermittent fasting, from a diet tracker to tools like a weight loss app free of distractions.
FEATURES OF FASTING TRACKER
√ Personalized Fasting Plans: Tailor your intermittent fasting schedule to fit your lifestyle, whether it’s OMAD, water fasting, or freeform fasting. Achieve your health and fitness goals with precision.
√ Custom Fasting Timers: Track your fasting and eating windows easily with a reliable timer. Monitor your progress during long fasts or short intermittent fasts effortlessly.
√ Reminders and Notifications: Never miss your fasting start or stop times. Get gentle reminders for fasting, water intake, and weight check-ins to stay on track.
√ Insights & Analytics: Access detailed stats and trends to understand your fasting journey better. Use these insights to adjust and improve your fasting routine for maximum results.
√ Ad-Free Experience: Stay fully focused on your goals without the distractions of ads. FastFocus ensures a clean, simple experience to help you succeed.
√ Minimalist Design: A sleek and easy-to-use interface keeps your fasting journey clear and straightforward, making it perfect for beginners and experienced fasters alike.
MORE REASONS TO LOVE FASTFOCUS
FastFocus is a convenient fasting tracker designed to simplify your journey toward better health. Unlike complex health apps, FastFocus is distraction-free, making it ideal for anyone looking for a clean and focused experience. Whether you’re fasting for weight loss, mindfulness, or wellness, this app offers all the tools you need in one place.
It’s perfect for beginners starting their intermittent fasting journey or experienced fasters seeking a reliable and minimalist fasting timer. With no extra integrations or unnecessary features, FastFocus helps you focus entirely on your goals.

bluejetty:00065958:ios.description:
********************
The game that started the legend of DRAGON QUEST is here at last for mobile devices!
Discover the RPG that won the hearts of two generations!
Enter a fantasy world of sword, magic, and monsters in one standalone package!
Download it once, and there’s nothing else to buy, and nothing else to download!
********************
◆ Prologue
The peace of fair Alefgard has been shattered by the appearance of the nefarious master of the night known as the Dragonlord, and the Sphere of Light which for so long kept the forces of darkness in check has been stolen!
It’s time for you, a young warrior through whose veins flows the blood of the legendary hero Erdrick, to set out on a quest to vanquish the Dragonlord, and save the land from darkness!
◆ Game Features
・First in the Legendary Series
Originally released as Dragon Warrior, you can now experience the classic retro RPG experience that swept up millions of Japanese players back in the Eighties...and never let go!
Become the descendant of the legendary hero Erdrick, and embark on an epic journey through the historic realm of Alefgard, tackling fearsome foes and perplexing puzzles on your way to the dread Dragonlord’s lair!
・Simple, Intuitive Controls
The game’s controls are designed to work perfectly with the vertical layout of any modern mobile device, and the position of the movement button can be changed to facilitate both one- and two-handed play.
・Experience the legendary RPG loved by millions in Japan and worldwide! Created by a legendary trio with the master creator Yuji Horii, the revolutionary synthesizer score and orchestration by Koichi Sugiyama, and art by master manga artist Akira Toriyama (Dragon Ball). 
--------------------
[OS Compatibility]
iOS 12.0 or higher

bluejetty:00073818:ios.summary: Welcome to The Sculpt Society, an innovative Sculpt, Dance Cardio + Strength fitness platform led by celebrity trainer Megan Roup, dedicated to empowering women with transformative workouts. This app is not just about fitness; it's a moveme
bluejetty:00073818:ios.description:
Welcome to The Sculpt Society, an innovative Sculpt, Dance Cardio + Strength fitness platform led by celebrity trainer Megan Roup, dedicated to empowering women with transformative workouts. This app is not just about fitness; it's a movement towards feeling confident, strong, and in love with your body.
Our programs cater to all levels, whether you are a beginner or an advanced fitness enthusiast, ensuring everyone can enjoy the benefits of a healthier, more active lifestyle.
Dynamic Workout Routines
The Sculpt Society offers an extensive range of exercises and classes, blending the fun of dance cardio with the efficacy of sculpting workouts. These workouts are designed to make you sweat, smile, and feel invigorated.
Expansive Class Selection
Our app features over 1,000 on-demand classes and multiple LIVE classes each week. These include a variety of workout styles - from low-impact sculpting, to strength building, to high energy dance cardio classes, as well as safe and efficient prenatal and postnatal workouts that help new and expecting mothers keep moving throughout their pregnancy journey. Dive into the tranquility of our yoga sessions, or find your center with our stretch and meditation classes. With new content added regularly, your workout routine will always be fresh and exciting.
The Sculpt Society Method
The Sculpt Society method is unique. We combine powerful sculpting exercises to tone your muscles with easy-to-follow dance cardio, ensuring a fun and effective workout every time. Our goal is to deliver a great workout experience in less than an hour, no matter where you are. This makes it perfect for busy schedules, allowing you to squeeze in a workout session anytime, anywhere.
Our workouts are designed to boost your heart rate and sculpt your way to long, lean muscles. Whether you opt for a quick 10-minute session or a full 45-minute class, you’ll conclude each workout feeling accomplished and sweaty! Within just a few weeks of consistent practice, you'll begin to see results.
For those looking to enhance their workouts, we offer options to incorporate equipment such as hand weights, resistance bands, a Pilates ball, sliders, and ankle weights. These additions can take your workout to the next level, helping you achieve even more significant results.
The Sculpt Society app is incredibly user-friendly and accessible. You can stream our workouts from any device, anywhere in the world. Whether you’re working out at home, traveling, or taking The Sculpt Society to the gym, our mobile workouts are available globally. We understand that internet access can be a challenge sometimes. That's why we've enabled offline viewing. Simply download any video for offline viewing and never miss a workout again.
Join the Community
Join our #TSSfam today and see why The Sculpt Society has become a beloved workout routine for thousands of women worldwide. Start your fitness journey with us, and witness a transformation that goes beyond the physical. To access all our features and content, subscribe to The Sculpt Society on a monthly or yearly basis with an auto-renewing subscription right inside the app. Our pricing is designed to be affordable and varies by region, ensuring it's accessible to everyone.
Terms of Service: https://app.thesculptsociety.com/tos
Privacy Policy: https://app.thesculptsociety.com/privacy
This app is proudly powered by VidApp.
Join us now and redefine your fitness journey with The Sculpt Society!

bluejetty:00069557:ios.name: Solitaire Crime Stories
bluejetty:00069557:ios.summary: Solitaire Crime Stories is an exciting new Solitaire game which will carry you away into a world of fascinating criminal investigations, colorful characters and stunning locations. Test your skills by completing interesting levels and unrav
bluejetty:00069557:ios.description:
Solitaire Crime Stories is an exciting new Solitaire game which will carry you away into a world of fascinating criminal investigations, colorful characters and stunning locations. Test your skills by completing interesting levels and unraveling the mysteries of the town of Springdale!
 Springdale is a small American town that lives in peace and quiet... but that’s only at first glance. Everyone hides secrets here, secrets that could tear this carefree town apart. Mysterious murders and dark family secrets are only some of the riddles for our young journalist heroine Lana Whitt to unravel. With the support of Assistant Sheriff Bill Maite and your deductive powers, she is ready to go to the very end in her search for the truth. Examine crime scenes, analyze clues and interrogate suspects — a deep dive into the world of real detective work awaits you so you can apprehend the wrongdoers. Forget about your everyday problems and enter a world of investigations, secrets and malevolent plots in this unique virtual detective tale.
 Solitaire Crime Stories is a game about the exciting adventures of journalist Lana Whitt and her assistant Bill. Visit all of the different corners of Springdale and talk to dozens of colorful characters — from pizza delivery men to ruthless gangsters! Get inspired and fascinated by the many stories written in the tradition of the best English detective fiction!
 To solve the crimes, players need to develop their Solitaire playing skills. Solitaire Crime Stories will appeal to both novices and masters of the genre, because the game can provide hours of interesting plays and fascinating puzzles. Powerful boosters will help you complete even the most complex level, letting you to clear the playing field even in the space of a few seconds.
 Tired of investigating? Then meet Max, the cute kitten which is waiting for you, always ready to play and have fun. Complete Solitaire levels to take care of the kitten and play with him, as well as making him new toys and decorations. 
 The many features of Solitaire Crime Stories include:
 - solving fascinating puzzles to find clues and solve crimes
 - visiting unique locations and meeting many interesting characters
 - playing hundreds of levels of Solitaire
 - playing with Max the kitten in a separate game mode
 - playing offline without worrying about an Internet connection
 - enjoying the wonderful graphics, colorful characters and gorgeous locations
 - untangling the knot of mysteries in the town of Springdale
 Lana Whitt is waiting for your help in investigating the crimes that have shaken this little town. Only your Solitaire victories will help her find the trails of cunning criminals! Become a Solitaire master and a talented detective in one in Solitaire Crime Stories!

bluejetty:00042422:ios.description:
Are you feeling anxious, stressed, vulnerable, lonely, heartbroken, or helpless? Whether you're dealing with a breakup, divorce, trust issues, dating challenges, toxic relationships, family conflicts, personal insecurities, or navigating other major life transitions like career changes, relocation, parenthood, health challenges, the loss of a loved one, or simply needing a listening ear, LiftTalk offers a safe 1-on-1 space for guidance and support, helping you find emotional stability, mental clarity, and relationship growth.
LiftTalk is here for you every step of the way, guiding you through daily life and its complexities. Trusted by thousands of users and professionals, our platform is the preferred choice for those seeking expert guidance. Our experienced and certified professionals are more than just coaches; they are advocates committed to nurturing your emotional, mental, and relationship wellness.
Join a community that genuinely cares, and receive expert advice and continuous support in all areas of life. Let every conversation with LiftTalk be a step towards improved relationship health and emotional well-being.
LiftTalk's online coaches are professionals and experienced individuals from diverse backgrounds around the world, consisting of counselors, therapists, life coaches and all kinds of active practitioners. They stand ready to work collaboratively with you, empowering you to overcome challenges and achieve your relationship goals.
===Our app offers===
* Private 1-on-1 conversations: Experience the security and comfort of confidential and anonymous 1-on-1 sessions. Feel free to express your emotions, discuss sensitive topics, and share your concerns. Our advanced encryption also ensures that every message, call, and video is securely protected, offering you a safe space for open dialogue.
* Instant coach matching: Need assistance right away? Besides browsing and selecting a coach from the main page, the instant matching feature can swiftly evaluate and pair you with a coach who best aligns with your preferences and needs. 
* All-in-one connection: Our app delivers the convenience of an all-in-one seamless connection via text, call, or video sessions and engaging in meaningful conversations. Additionally, our robust secure payment system offers you a worry-free checkout experience, ensuring your peace of mind with every transaction.
* 24/7 availability: Access guidance and support anytime, anywhere. Regardless of whether you're facing a sudden conflict, dealing with an urgent concern, or simply in need of a listening ear, our LiftTalk coaches are readily available to assist you.
* Start a session right away: No need to wait or delay seeking support for your relationship. Our app ensures swift and convenient access to our diverse selection of LiftTalk coaches, providing immediate help at your fingertips.
* Flexible scheduling: We strive to accommodate your busy schedule, whether it is an early morning, late evening, or weekend session, we have a coach ready for you. Our goal is to ensure that you can access the support you need at a time that works best for you. 
* Affordable online sessions: LiftTalk presents a cost-effective alternative to traditional therapy. Recognizing that seeking relationship guidance is a significant investment in your partnership, we offer our online services at affordable rates to ensure you can access the help you need without financial strain.
* Discover SafeSpace: We provide an in-app inclusive place where you can post your current life challenges anonymously and let our coaches offer their support for you. You belong to a community that truly understands you. 
===What to do next===
Take the proactive step in improving your relationship with LiftTalk, where privacy, flexibility, accessibility, affordability and personalized support are at the forefront of our service. Download LiftTalk now and embark on your journey towards a more fulfilled and happier you.

bluejetty:00098106:ios.description:
Pomodoro Technique is a time management method by Francesco Cirillo in the 1980s.
There are six steps in the original technique:
1. Decide on the task to be done.
2. Set the pomodoro timer (traditionally to 25 minutes).
3. Work on the task.
4. End work when the timer rings and put a checkmark on a piece of paper.
5. If you have fewer than four checkmarks, take a short break (3–5 minutes) and then return to step 2; otherwise continue to step 6.
6. After four pomodoros, take a longer break (15–30 minutes), reset your checkmark count to zero, then go to step 1.

Picktime is a free online booking system and appointment scheduling software designed to help
bluejetty:00042348:ios.description:
Transform your business with just a few clicks by accessing the renowned appointment scheduling app, Picktime, right from the palm of your hand.
Picktime is a free online booking system and appointment scheduling software designed to help small businesses manage their appointments, classes, group bookings, rental reservations, and staff. With Picktime, salons, gyms, doctors, cleaning businesses, consultants, tutors, and equipment rental businesses can easily manage their schedules and streamline their operations.
Picktime allows you to create a customizable booking page where customers can easily book their appointments, classes, equipment and events. 
Stay Engaged
Picktime supports automated reminders, so you can minimize no-shows and keep your schedule running smoothly. Not only that, but users can also customize the reminder mail so that your client never misses an appointment again. 
Manage Bookings in a Flash
Change of plans or rescheduling? Picktime can handle it all in the twinkle of an eye. Rescheduling, cancellations, no show, or late entry Picktime understands it all and has made it easier for your clients to rebook. 
Plus, with Picktime's class/group booking feature, you can easily schedule bookings for multiple clients in the same time slot. It also supports attendance tracking, so you can keep track of which clients have attended their appointments.
Contactless Payment & Invoice
Picktime allows you to accept payments online using PayPal or Stripe, so your clients can conveniently pay for their appointments in advance. It's not limited to simple transactions, generating invoices effortlessly for the services undertaken.
It also supports multiple locations so you can manage appointments across different branches of your business.
Look Around
With Picktime's recurring bookings feature, you can schedule appointments that repeat at regular intervals, such as weekly or monthly. 
How often do you have time to stop and check who's the most diligent person on your staff or who's doing nothing but sitting around? The Picktime's Round Robin feature ensures the automatic distribution with a fair share of bookings, so no one in your team gets overburdened. 
Picktime also supports automatic timezone conversion, so clients can see your availability in their timezone, making booking appointments easier.
Picktime's waitlist feature allows you to automatically add clients to the waitlist if a time slot is full, so you can quickly fill any cancellations or no-shows. 
Unique integrations
Picktime integrates with Google, Apple, and Outlook calendars, so you can easily sync your schedule across different platforms. Most businesses don't even require physical existence to complete a service. You can also schedule virtual meetings to connect with your clients remotely. Picktime offers integration with all your favourite apps, including - Video Meetings, Calendars, Booking Widgets, CRMs, Email Marketing, and more.
Work Safely and Securely
Built-in app security protects your data on the device and in transit while using the client's trusted industry leader platform. We have created a process through which users can limit their staff's access to the data and control and edit the admin rights. 
Picktime's resource feature allows you to schedule your resources and make the rental process more accessible. You can also generate detailed reports on your business operations to gain insights into your performance and make data-driven decisions.
Check out our complete feature list and plans at www.picktime.com 
Picktime is free, easy to set up, and fully customizable to meet your unique business needs. Download Picktime today and start streamlining your booking and scheduling processes!
Our team is always at your service! For more information and support, contact us through our website in-app chat or email us at support@picktime.com
