bluejetty:00035224:ios.description:
Step into a world of creativity, style, and adventure in Avatar Boca Queen: Airplane! Create your own avatar, design beautiful spaces, explore the airport, and experience exciting new adventures.
Bring your imagination to life as you customize characters, decorate rooms, and interact with a vibrant world full of fun activities.
Key Features
- Create Your Own Avatar :
Design a unique avatar that represents your style! Choose from many hairstyles, outfits, accessories, and facial features to create a character that truly feels like you. Mix and match styles to build your perfect look.
- Matching Outfit Mini Game :
Test your fashion sense in a fun outfit-matching challenge! Choose the best clothes, shoes, and accessories to match the style and score points. Perfect for players who love fashion and creativity.
- Design and Decorate Your Dream Home : 
Become an interior designer! Customize your house with furniture, lights, tables, decorations, and plants. Create cozy rooms or stylish modern spaces — the choice is yours.
- Explore the Interactive Airport :
Discover an exciting airport world filled with interactive elements. Check in passengers, explore the terminal, and experience the fun atmosphere of travel.
- New Flight Attendant Game :
Become a flight attendant and manage the airplane cabin! Help passengers, serve them during the flight, and make sure everyone has a comfortable trip. Experience what it's like to work in the sky!
Why You'll Love Avatar Boca Queen :
• Create and customize your own avatar
• Design and decorate beautiful houses
• Play fun fashion mini-games
• Explore an interactive airport world
• Experience the new Flight Attendant gameplay
• Endless creativity and storytelling possibilities
Whether you love fashion, design, role-playing, or adventure, Avatar Boca Queen: Airplane offers a fun and relaxing experience for everyone.
Create your story, design your world, and start your adventure today!

• Deposit checks

bluejetty:00006710:android.name: QR Code Scanner Barcode Reader
bluejetty:00006710:android.summary: This QR scanner app will let you scan and read any barcode in a second. Thanks to this barcode reader and QR scanner you will feel comfortable in any environment and will be able to obtain any necessary information in the shortest possible
bluejetty:00006710:android.description:
This QR scanner app will let you scan and read any barcode in a second. Thanks to this barcode reader and QR scanner you will feel comfortable in any environment and will be able to obtain any necessary information in the shortest possible time.
QR codes and barcodes have become omnipresent. They allow us to quickly and conveniently get to know valuable information. When we travel, these codes help us to promptly find the necessary direction, get a brief historical reference about a certain place of attraction or download the train schedule. When we are shopping, they allow us to compare the prices and get access to discount coupons.
The codes help us to compress large volumes of information into a few millimeters of the precious screen space. After you extract it, you will be able to visit diverse websites, resort to profitable offers, connect to a Wi-Fi network without introducing the password and carry out many useful functions.
Which Type of Information Can This QR Code Reader Process
This QR and barcode reader is capable of processing the following types of information provided in the form of a code:
Text
Contacts
Timetable
Wi-Fi
Product
ISBN
URL
Price
Many more
How to Use the App
The algorithm of using the application is genuinely simple:
1. Spot a barcode or a QR code.
2. Point the camera of your device on this code and do not push any buttons — the app does not require any additional commands or clicks.
3. Wait for a second to let the gadget recognize the information.
4. Read the information obtained from the code.
The history of all your scans will be saved automatically. You will be able to come back to any item that you previously scanned at any moment.
Instead of using the camera, you can upload the codes from your gallery.
Advanced Opportunities
Once you download this free QR reader for Android, you will never need to resort to any other scanner barcode app. 
If you find yourself in the dark, just turn on the flashlight to use this QR reader free.
Apart from scanning the codes, you can also generate them. The generator comes especially handy when you need to share your contacts with new friends, acquaintances, partners, clients or colleagues.
Advantages of the App
In addition to the functionality that was described above, this QR code scanner can boast of the following advantages:
1. It is distributed 100% at no cost. You will not need to pay for anything either at the moment of installation or later when upgrading to newer versions.
2. This piece of software is compatible with any Android device, be it a smartphone or tablet, regardless of its brand and model.
3. The app is lightweight, it downloads in a matter of seconds and occupies minimum space in the gadget's memory. It will not make your phone slow down.
4. Thanks to a highly intuitive interface and sleek design, it will take you just a couple of minutes to figure out how this barcode reader functions.
This QR code and barcode scanner will make your life significantly easier. Feel free to install this QR barcode app right now to enjoy its multiple benefits!

bluejetty:00044590:ios.description:
SmartLabels is a companion app designed specifically for use with physical SmartLabels QR code stickers. Physical labels are required to utilize the box tracking and inventory features.
--------------------------------------------------
Organize your home, garage, attic, and moving boxes in seconds with SmartLabels, the ultimate QR code storage tracker and home inventory system.
If you are looking for smart labels for storage bins, you have found the perfect solution. Never wonder what’s inside a tote or moving box again. Simply peel, stick, scan, and catalog your belongings using our color-coded scannable QR code stickers.
KEY FEATURES:
• SCAN & CATALOG: Link physical SmartLabels QR code stickers to your digital inventory instantly.
• SMART PHOTO ASSIST: Take a photo of your items and let AI automatically identify, catalog, and list them in your box.
• FAST SEARCH: Search by item name, tag, category, or location to pinpoint exactly where your items are stored. Use the app to scan labels and find your stuff in seconds.
• LOCATION TRACKING: Keep track of items across your garage, attic, basement, shed, or storage unit. 
• CUSTOM FIELDS: Add dates, values, text notes, and toggles for detailed item tracking.
• EXPORT & SHARE: Export your box inventory documents easily for moving, insurance, or personal records.
PERFECT FOR:
- Storage Bins & Totes: Apply QR code labels for storage directly to your plastic bins to identify seasonal decorations, tools, and sports gear without opening the lid.
- Moving & Packing: Label moving boxes and find what you need without unpacking everything.
- Small Business Inventory: Track stock, parts, and supplies efficiently.
Say goodbye to messy bins and wasted time searching for your stuff. Get your scannable labels and upgrade your home organization with SmartLabels today!

It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what else you can do with Keystone Bank:
Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes, and photos of receipts and checks.
Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
Transfer money between your accounts
Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it
View and save your monthly statements
Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the Keystone Bank app, you must be enrolled as a Keystone Bank Internet Banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

bluejetty:00034402:ios.name: Infinity Nikki
bluejetty:00034402:ios.summary: Infinity Nikki, developed by Infold Games, is the fifth installment in the Nikki series—a multi-platform open-world game built on the UE5 engine. It's an enchanting experience dedicated to creating and collecting beauty. Nikki, together wit
bluejetty:00034402:ios.description:
Infinity Nikki, developed by Infold Games, is the fifth installment in the Nikki series—a multi-platform open-world game built on the UE5 engine. It's an enchanting experience dedicated to creating and collecting beauty. Nikki, together with Momo, harnesses the power of Whim and ability outfits, facing every challenge with courage and discovering miracles along the way.
[New Main Story Chapter] Golden Dust
The final chapter of the Itzaland main story is now available, along with the new region, Heaven's Reach, open for exploration. Dreams of a golden celebration stir as echoes of the Titan civilization linger... Set out for the Golden City, follow the Mark of the Cycle, and witness the finale of Itzaland's fate!
[Open World] Explore and Discover Unseen Wonders
Step into a vast, living world where every horizon hides a new mystery. Transform through Gigantification to move faster, leap higher, and unleash a thunderous Roar to take on the massive Behemoths. Use the Sticky Claw to glide across the skies and reach hidden spots. With every step, your sense of freedom, discovery, and adventure grows.
[Ingenious Combat] Shape Your Adventure
Nikki's new Archery ability turns combat into a skillful, interactive experience. Use bows to break shields, solve puzzles, and unlock hidden paths, blending exploration and strategy. Choose your Battle Companions for offense or defense roles, allowing you to tailor your own style and approach to every challenge.
[Online Co-op] A Journey Shared, Souls No Longer Walking Alone
Meet Nikkis from parallel worlds and embark on a beautiful adventure together. When the Starbell softly rings, friends will be reunited. Whether walking hand in hand or exploring freely on your own, your journey will be filled with joy every step of the way.
[Home Building] Nikki's Floating Island
Build your dream home on an island of your own. Design every space your way, grow crops, gather stars, raise fish... This is more than an island; it's a living dream woven from Whim.
[Fashion Photography] Capture the World Through Your Lens, Master the Perfect Palette
Mix and match colors and styles to capture the beauty of the world. Use Momo's Camera to customize your favorite filters, settings, and photo styles, preserving each precious moment in a single shot.
An Open-World Styling Fantasy！
Thank you for being interested in Infinity Nikki. We look forward to meeting you in Miraland!

bluejetty:00063291:ios.description:
** Winner of 5 Webby Awards - Draw a Stickman Franchise **
** Played over 100 Million Times around the Globe **
Grab your pencil and get ready for the most creative DRAW A STICKMAN adventure yet!
Imagination is the key, as you enter a magical storybook full of mystery and wonder, unusual creatures and enigmatic puzzles! Create your own original stickman and then watch it come to life in DRAW A STICKMAN: EPIC 2! Challenge yourself to unlock every secret, collect every drawing and share your creativity with the world!
BRING YOUR DRAWINGS TO LIFE
Unleash your creativity as you draw a Stickman from your own unique perspective, and then watch your animated hero come to life before your eyes! Make every idea a reality by saving drawings in your Sketchbook, and sharing them with friends!
A NEW STORY
Embark on a perilous journey through time! Draw your Stickman and create a friend! But be warned….disaster falls upon your ally! It’s up to you to become the hero! Maneuver your way through the magical world of EPIC 2 in a quest to save your partner!
YOUR DRAWINGS MATTER
Create and save unlimited drawings in your Sketchbook that comes to life throughout your adventure!
SHARE AND RECEIVE DRAWINGS WITH FRIENDS
With the new share feature, you can now send your creations to your friends. They will then be able to use your drawings in their own epic adventures! 
FIGHT EPIC BATTLES
Face off against inked-out goblins, tongue-lashing frogs, fire-breathing dragons, and BIG bosses! You must use your own strategies to solve intriguing challenges and puzzles, while battling all new villains!
Jump in to this action-packed adventure that allows for endless creativity! 
As you explore each colorful environment, choose from an assortment of drawing pencils and tools to help you successfully overcome every obstacle along the way.
New features and enhancements allow you to choose from a larger color palette, along with a variety of pencil sizes. With the new share feature, send your drawings to your friends! Unlock hidden Color Buddies, locate puzzle pieces, and enjoy new drawing pencils for Wires, Eggs, and Ice! This is an experience like no other, personalized by you!
DRAW A STICKMAN: EPIC 2 is the sequel you’ve been waiting for and is sure to offer hours of entertainment to avid gamers and creative minds alike!

bluejetty:00070504:ios.description:
Le JDD vous informe en premier : l’actualité politique, les news internationales et toute l'info
société en une seule appTéléchargez gratuitement la nouvelle application du JDD sur votre mobile et tablette, et ne
manquez plus aucune actualité et infos en France et dans le monde.
Le Journal du dimanche c’est surtout 75 années consacrées à vous fournir une information
factuelle, fiable, précise et pertinente sur des sujets d’actualités, en France et dans le monde.
Expliquer, anticiper, surprendre : découvrez les contenus qui répondent à la promesse du JDD
tout au long de la semaine.
Retrouvez toutes les rubriques phares du journal :
Info politique, international, société, économie, sport, culture…Le JDD partage avec vous ses
révélations, ses interviews exclusives, ses enquêtes, ses sondages, ses analyses, ses tribunes...
pour tout comprendre des sujets qui font et feront l'actualité de demain.
Le JDD s’enrichit :
Dans une préoccupation de continuer à vous fournir un journal de qualité, notre offre
s’enrichit avec son nouveau rendez-vous hebdomadaire, le JDNews ! Retrouvez chaque
semaine un décryptage de l’information: analyses, enquêtes exclusives et reportages sur les
news politiques, économiques, sociales et culturelles.
Les fonctionnalités de l'application :
-Vos éditions en version numérique : n’attendez plus le dimanche et accédez au dernier
numéro de votre journal en version numérique le samedi dès 23h45, ainsi qu'au magazine Le
JDNews. Profitez de l’expérience double page sur votre iPad en l’orientant en format paysage.
- Ma sélection : pas le temps ? Inscrivez-vous pour ajouter des articles à votre sélection et les
lire plus tard
- Personnalisation de l'affichage : passez au mode sombre pour un confort de lecture
optimisé, ou modifiez la taille de la police
Abonnement numérique :
Être abonné numérique, c’est avoir chaque jour un rendez-vous avec le JDD ! Découvrez les
avantages de notre offre d’abonnement numérique sans engagement :
- Accès illimité aux articles sur l'application et le site JDD
- Vos éditions en version numérique dès 23h45 le samedi sur le site et l’application : toutes les
semaines le dernier numéro du JDD ainsi ainsi qu'au magazine Le JDNews
- Du lundi au samedi à 18h30, notre newsletter abonnés Le Journal de Demain- Nos newsletters thématiques hebdomadaires (Le Supplément Politique, Bon Dimanche et
Bon Dimanche à Paris)
- Une expérience publicitaire allégée sur l'application et le site JDD
Une difficulté sur votre abonnement ? Notre équipe relation client se tient à votre disposition
- par formulaire de contact : https://abonnement.lejdd.fr/aide-et-contact
- par téléphone au 01 87 64 68 11, du lundi au vendredi de 8h30 à 19h00, le samedi de 9h à
13h et le dimanche de 8h à 12h
Conditions générales de vente : https://abonnement.lejdd.fr/cgv.html
Charte de données personnelles et cookies et conditions générales d'utilisation :
https://www.lejdd.fr/divers/La-Charte-Donnees-Personnelles-et-Cookies
Mentions légales : https://www.lejdd.fr/divers/Mentions-Legales

bluejetty:00099577:ios.description:
Press play to grow. Your 15-minute daily book cast.
Turn spare moments into real growth with BookCast. We transform must-read nonfiction into 15-minute audio summaries so you can listen anywhere, learn faster, and move
confidently toward your goals.
Why BookCast
Immersive audio. Professional, clear, and pleasant narration.
15-minute insights. No fluff — big ideas with actionable takeaways.
Goal-based picks. Set your aims (career, health, focus) and get personalized recommendations.
A growing library. Explore business, productivity, health, psychology, creativity, and more.
Daily micro-learning. Fresh highlights keep your learning streak strong.
Listen anywhere. Offline play, background mode, and speed control for commutes or workouts.
Smart discovery. Search, curated lists, and book requests when you need something new.
What You’ll Achieve
Read less, understand more. Capture insights in minutes.
Turn idle time into a lasting learning habit.
Replace doom-scrolling with purposeful listening.
Apply ideas right away at work and in life.
Build a personal library of book summaries.
Who It’s For
Busy professionals, creators, teachers, freelancers, students — anyone who wants fast nonfiction insights through audio.
How It Works
Set goals and topics.
Press play on a curated summary.
Learn in 15 minutes with clear ideas.
Apply the takeaways and grow day by day.
Categories You’ll Love
Business & Money – leadership, decisions, investing.
Productivity – focus, habits, time management.
Psychology – mindset, motivation, resilience.
Relationships – communication, empathy, teamwork.
Health – energy, sleep, mental fitness.
Creativity – innovation, storytelling, systems.
Features
Premium audio by professional narrators.
Concise structure with key ideas and examples.
Personalized recommendations that improve as you listen.
Daily Highlight keeps your streak alive.
Offline and background playback.
Powerful search and book requests.
Use BookCast To
Prep fast for meetings or interviews.
Spark ideas for your next project.
Refresh classics in one listen.
Build habits that compound daily.
Your Growth, Your Pace
Not a speed reader? Prefer audio? BookCast meets you where you are with quick, engaging summaries anytime.
Ready to read less and understand more?
Press play to grow. With BookCast, personal growth is always one listen away.
Listen. Learn. Level up.

bluejetty:00014696:ios.name: Schedule Anyone
bluejetty:00014696:ios.summary:
SUMMARY
Manage your business anytime, anywhere using any device plus marketing with your own website. The easiest to use appointment scheduling software.
Templates available for hair salon, nail spa, barber shop, pet shop, personal trainer
bluejetty:00014696:ios.description:
SUMMARY
Manage your business anytime, anywhere using any device plus marketing with your own website. The easiest to use appointment scheduling software.
Templates available for hair salon, nail spa, barber shop, pet shop, personal trainer, fitness class, doctor, tutoring, auto detailing, maid service, nail techs, carpet cleaning, pool cleaning, plumbing, landscaping, tattoo, tour groups, realtors, and other personal service businesses and independent contractors.
YOUR APPOINTMENT BOOK / PLANNER
• Setup recurring appointments
• Set custom times (service time, processing time, finish out time, etc) and pricing for services
• Services already have the business rules you need, for example:
* Have a haircut and color appointment? The finish out is automatically removed
* Have a manicure and pedicure appointment with two different staff members? The services are automatically scheduled at the same time (not back to back)
• Want to override any business rule or move an appointment? No problem, it's as easy as drag and drop.
• Our iPad app and website allow easy drag and drop to move and create new appointments
• View your booking calendar in day, week, or month calendar views
• Plus many other features including: wait-list management, walk-in management, the ability to create overlapping appointments, group parties / private parties, automatically block out off days and holidays, and much more...
POINT-OF-SALE / CREDIT CARD PROCESSING
• Save money with our low credit card processing rates
• Save time doing paperwork with our easy to use interactive reports
• Need a merchant account for each independent staff member? No problem, our software supports multiple merchant accounts
• Our cash drawer feature allows you to keep track of your cash
• Customers can sign with their finger or you can print a receipt to have the customer sign
• Text & email customers beautifully designed receipts
BOOKING REMINDER
• Automatically send appointment reminders and confirmations via text,e-mail or both, specify the time before the appointment you want the reminder to be sent
• Email/Text receipts to clients
• Customize the emails sent to your clients
YOUR DATA
• All your data is backed up (to multiple locations in our safe and secure data center) the moment it is saved. Even if you lose your phone, iPad, and computer your information is still safe and secure.
• Contact us and we'll help you migrate data from another system
WEBSITE
• Customers get a headache-free website under your own domain name (www.your-domain.com).
• You start offering a new service, add a new staff, a staff member leaves? It immediately shows up on your website.
INVENTORY MANAGEMENT
• Automate ordering using our automatic order generator by ordering what you sold over a specific date range, since your last order, or based on a specific desired stock amount which you specify
• Seamlessly email orders to your distributors and product reps
• Easily print orders and product lists
SECURITY
• Role-based security allows you to set what each staff member's access
• Location-based security allows you to set which staff members can login from home to view their schedule
STAFF MANAGEMENT / PAYROLL
• Manage your employees times by creating a schedule they can see on their phone (or any other device) and allows them to clock-in clock-out only from company computers.
• Our easy to use timesheet allow you to track time and manage costs
SUBSCRIBING IN-APP 
• Use the starter version for free, upgrade to the independent package for $9.99/mo or silver business subscription for $39.99/mo; payment is charged to your iTunes account upon confirmation of purchase
• Monthly subscriptions automatically renew. You can manage auto-renew of your subscription from your iTunes account settings at http://support.apple.com/kb/ht4098
• For more information visit our privacy policy: www.ScheduleAnyone.com/info/PrivacyPolicy and our terms of service: www.ScheduleAnyone.com/info/ProviderAgreement

bluejetty:00014916:ios.description:
Only download this app if you are a BlackBerry Technology customer. Specifically designed for the BlackBerry Dynamics secure mobility platform, this app allows both Zoom and BlackBerry Technology customers to take advantage of Zoom features in a secure BlackBerry MDM deployment. 
If you are not a BlackBerry Technology customer, you can download the main Zoom iOS application from the iTunes store here: 
https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/zoom-cloud-meetings/id546505307?ls=1&mt=8
Stay connected wherever you go – start or join a secure meeting with flawless video and audio, instant screen sharing, and cross-platform instant messaging - for free! 
Zoom is #1 in customer satisfaction and the best unified communication experience on mobile.
It's super easy! Install the free Zoom app, click on "New Meeting," and invite up to 100 people to join you on video! Connect with anyone on iPad, iPhone, other mobile devices, Windows, Mac, Zoom Rooms, H.323/SIP room systems, and telephones.
VIDEO MEETINGS FROM ANYWHERE
-Best video meeting quality
-Easily join a meeting or start an instant meeting with phone, email, or company contacts
-Virtual backgrounds on iPhone 8, iPad 5, iPad Pro and all later models
COLLABORATE ON THE GO
-Best iPhone and iPad content and mobile screen sharing quality
-Co-annotate over shared content
-Real-time whiteboard collaboration on iPad
UNLIMITED MESSAGING (WITH PHOTOS, FILES, AND MORE)
-Reach people instantly with messages, files, images, links, and gifs
-Quickly respond or react to threaded conversations with emojis
-Create or join public and private chat channels
MAKE, RECEIVE, AND MANAGE PHONE CALLS
-Effortlessly make or receive calls with your business number
-Get voicemail and call recording with transcripts
-Use call delegation to make/receive calls on behalf of others
-Set up auto-receptionists to autonomously answer and route calls
AND MORE….
-Safe driving mode while on the road and works with Apple Carplay
-Siri Shortcuts to customize your own voice commands to start, join, and listen to a list of upcoming meetings
-Use your iOS app to start your meeting or for direct share in Zoom Rooms
-Join Zoom Webinars as a view-only participant or panelist
-Works over wifi, 5G, 4G/LTE, and 3G networks
ZOOM LICENSE INFORMATION:
-Any free or paid license can be used with the app
-Zoom Phone is an add-on to paid Zoom licenses
-A paid Zoom subscription is required for certain product features
Follow us on social @zoom!
Have a question? Contact us at http://support.zoom.us.

bluejetty:00029542:ios.summary:
HFG Entertainments proudly presents “ESCAPE ROOM: MYSTICAL TALES”, and invites you to join this adventure journey of a point-and-click game.
The mystical tales of the game's challenge await you; are you up for it? You are in the appropriat
bluejetty:00029542:ios.description:
HFG Entertainments proudly presents “ESCAPE ROOM: MYSTICAL TALES”, and invites you to join this adventure journey of a point-and-click game.
The mystical tales of the game's challenge await you; are you up for it? You are in the appropriate condition. Put yourself in an extreme circumstance from which you want to escape the room. Think outside the box and resolve hidden object games and mysteries behind you if you want to get through a difficult situation. Act wisely to locate the exit.
Try out your own skills! There are many enigmatic stages in the game, each with a number of exits. You need to use hints, Adventure puzzles, and the discovery of hidden rooms to get out of there. Enjoy an hour of brainteasers.
Each level has a unique set of puzzles and anime & realistic, stylized theme games, so you'll never get bored playing it. Our Mini-games have gorgeous interactive graphics that are colorful and adorned with visually appealing game-play elements. Make up your mind to enter a fun and logical game. Use observation, analysis, and logical thinking to get out of the enigmatic room.
Don't be hesitant to try our game if you love playing room escape games! Very amusing and smooth! We guarantee that playing with us will be an unforgettable experience! You must discover a way out of that place by looking for helpful hidden objects, using detective skills, and deciphering riddles and puzzles. Utilize your abilities to gather the necessary items in the fantasy world so that you can solve the puzzles and free yourself.
Start your mission and tackle complex mysteries involving hospitals, airplanes, trains, magic, theft, and various room escapes. It will be fascinating and fun. As you play different brain teasers, try to solve the clues to find the key, steal the artifacts, and find the exit door. Solve the puzzle-adventure games, and take part in a fantastic escape room experience.
Game features:
*Discover all the 50 levels of secrets!
*Daily rewards are available for free coins.
*Step by step hints features available
*Suitable for all gender age groups
*Exciting search for hidden objects
*Experience with unique riddles & puzzles
*Save your progress so you can play on multiple devices!
Available in 25 languages---- (English, Arabic, Catalan, Chinese (simplified), Chinese (Traditional), Czech, Danish, Dutch, French, Finnish, German, Greek, Hebrew, Hindi, Hungarian, Indonesian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Malay, Polish, Portuguese(Brazil), Portuguese(Portugal), Romanian, Russian, Slovak, Spanish, Swedish, Thai, Turkish, Vietnamese)

bluejetty:00080353:ios.description:
The AR Drawing by Tayasui app is an invaluable tool for artists looking to trace and sketch various designs. It provides an efficient and user-friendly platform for creating drawing and sketch art. With its step-by-step drawing lessons and the ability to trace selected images using tracing paper under the camera, it's an excellent resource for learning and practicing the art of tracing. Transforming sketches into art is made easy by using AR Drawing by Tayasui app to trace images, whether it's cartoons, buildings, objects, or eyes, onto tracing paper.
Using this you may learn and practice drawing. Also make tracing an image easy. Just select an image from the app or gallery apply filter to create image traceable. The image will appear on screen with camera open. Place phone about 1feet above and look into the phone and draw on paper.
The user can adjust the thickness and style of their lines, as well as use the eraser tool to correct any mistakes. They can also add additional elements or details to their sketch if desired. Once the user has finished their sketch, they can save it or share it with others. The app may also have features such as filters or color adjustments to further enhance the finished sketch.

bluejetty:00024066:ios.description:
Drawing is one of the most popular pastimes for children. That's why we decided to support young artists and created an exclusive Draw & Play application. The adorable characters come to life as the child draws them. We've also added a whole category of cute monsters and musical instruments to make your little one even more interested! 
The app is designed by experts in preschool development to develop imagination, attention, and fine motor skills. It has an intuitive design, user-friendly interface, voice prompts, and animations – everything needed to let even the smallest kiddies play.
Now, in addition to their favorite characters, young users can color in kind monsters who like to jam. The new characters play musical instruments, which stimulates creative thinking and sparks interest in music. A variety of drawing tools and special designs create a supportive space for children to express their creativity. And the sound effects and the ability to play with the drawn characters will definitely attract the attention of children!
Draw & Play is:
• filled with a large selection of pictures and characters to draw
• bursting with new packs with monsters and musical instruments
• designed using a unique teaching method
• a tool to develop fine motor skills
• a lifesaver in keeping your child busy anytime, anywhere
“Draw & Play” is a smart choice, both for those who are just getting acquainted with the world of educational games, and for those with children who are already in kindergarten or preparing for it.

Why Do So Many Users Trust Tidyfoto?
► Clean up automatically
No need to sort through your gallery — let the iPhone cleaner do the work for you. It automatically identifies the best photos, allowing you to clean up blurry and duplicate ones with just a few taps while keeping the very best photos that preserve your best memories.

Running low on storage but don’t want to lose your favorite videos? Tidyfoto lets you compress large video files without noticeable quality loss, helping you save valuable space while keeping every special moment perfectly intact.

- We've captured every city you've visited. Categorizing photos based on their location makes it easy to revisit your travel memories.

- Easy to use: With our intuitive interface, you can easily free up space manually or with AI assistance.
- Performance optimization: Improve your iPhone's speed and responsiveness with Tidyfoto. Our advanced AI technology frees up gigabytes of storage in seconds.
- Secure and Private: Your personal data is safe with us. Tidyfoto does not store your personal information.

bluejetty:00083897:ios.name: Bible Solitaire - Daily Pray
bluejetty:00083897:ios.summary: In today’s digital world, Bible Solitaire - Daily Pray stands out as a unique and creative game, offering believers a spiritually enriching experience. By combining the timeless wisdom of the Bible with the beloved game of Solitaire, it cre
bluejetty:00083897:ios.description:
In today’s digital world, Bible Solitaire - Daily Pray stands out as a unique and creative game, offering believers a spiritually enriching experience. By combining the timeless wisdom of the Bible with the beloved game of Solitaire, it creates a space not only for relaxation and entertainment but also for strengthening faith and fostering prayer.
Bible Solitaire helps players navigate the busyness of life and find peaceful moments of reflection. Each game session becomes an opportunity to connect with God, with every card flip and move serving as a way to practice and deepen faith. Players enjoy the excitement of the game while feeling inspired, comforted, and uplifted by biblical teachings.
How to Play:
- Tap or drag cards onto a card of a different color with a higher number.
- Move cards from A to K onto the Foundation piles.
- Complete the hand by collecting all four suits.
- Kings can be placed in empty columns, but no other cards can go there.
- Click the Deck to discover more moves.
Game Features:
- Daily Prayer: The game includes daily prayers, allowing players to dedicate their wins and joys to God while seeking His help.
- Track Mood: Players can record their moods and reflections, expressing both joys and struggles in life.
- Bible Revisiting: The Bible 365 allows players to read the Bible daily and check in on the calendar.
- Postcards to God: Players can send postcards to God, expressing praise and gratitude.
- Daily Quiz: Players can answer three questions about God each day to receive His blessings.
- Hint Feature: The Hint feature offers not just game tips but biblical wisdom and guidance to help players overcome challenges.
- Undo Feature: The Undo button allows players to reset and make new choices when they make a mistake, giving them a fresh start.
In essence, Bible Solitaire is not just a game—it’s a spiritual journey filled with hope, love, and faith. It invites players to find peace and purpose as they engage in a meaningful experience of devotion and prayer through the game’s cards.

bluejetty:00080189:ios.description:
Buckle up and get ready for an epic battle, because they are getting closer and hungrier! Brace yourself for an impact! Hope you’ve built your train right and can repel all those zombies. Use the best strategy to protect survivors from mutant hordes: rack that brain of yours or it will become someone’s dinner.
Gather survivors along the tracks and build your personal army! Everyone can become a hero in this post-apocalyptic world – with enough upgrades and a good weapon to boot. Level up your heroes, place them accordingly and choose the best units for the upcoming battle! Remember: each of them has their own unique ability, which can turn the tide of the battle in one single tap. Keep zombies on their toes. Don’t play favorites – everyone in such a diverse cast counts as a stepping stone to victory! There’s plenty of coins to collect and much more money to earn while you fight! Upgrade your base to keep the cash machine running idle, while you turn zombies into dust.
Use your logic and wit to create impenetrable defenses! How strong can your survivor army grow? How tall will your train cart get? Build it’s tower sky-high to place all the offensive power you could gather!
FEATURES:
- Endless fun! Take on waves of zombies one after the other!
- Unlock and discover new epic monsters! From small and fast zombies to huge boss fights with angry mutants!
- Collect and upgrade all the heroes on your team! Upgrade their unique stats and skills!
- Raise your tower! Create an unstoppable fortress!
- Manage your base and grow your income!
- Combine your units abilities for maximum destruction on the battlefield!
- Take the command in your hands or sit idle with auto-battle commands!
Ready to take on the challenge? Do not waste your time, download and play!

⭐ Stickman Combat Legend is the simplest stickman fighting game!!! 
This battle game will allow you to become one of the heroes of the Superhero team, fighting villains and protecting the entire planet. Enter the arena and battle for your life. If you enjoy playing games, this is the game for you because of its quick handling and wonderful features.
Players may select their Stickman Super Heroes, who they love most, upgrade their ultimate power as much as possible, compete in the tournament of all maps, and rise to the top of the global standings.

🤖 Single-player mode: Engage in infinite fights against various opponents across several maps.

⚔️ All you have to do is drag and drop your weapon to move about, then shoot, fire, or hurl it to eliminate the enemy. 
⚔️ Winning combat earns you coins, which you may use to unlock more and more skills & weapons for your Stickman Hero.
⚔️ Be careful! If your Stickman falls into the water, you will be sent to the "game over" screen, returned to the home screen, and the level will be restarted from the beginning.

bluejetty:00062405:ios.description:
Enjoy your favorite word game with cool new features! Download Lexulous and experience word mania like never before!
Played on 15 x 15 board, Lexulous is an uber new way to learn wonderful words while giving yourself a chance to test your vocabulary.
Lexulous is all about making words from the letter tiles. Each player has to create a word in their respective turn. It’s very simple:
◆ Pick up suitable letters from your tile rack of 8 tiles. 
◆ Place them wisely on the board to form words that score the highest points. 
◆ Check the word validity from the in-built Dictionary. 
◆ Click on Play to submit your move! And there’s your score!

bluejetty:00060748:ios.description:
Já somos mais de 10 milhões de pessoas utilizando o Skoob para organizar suas leituras e ler cada vez mais.
O Skoob é um “Assistente literário” e uma “Rede social para leitores”.   Como Assistente Literário, o Skoob oferece dezenas de ferramentas que organizam seus livros em uma estante virtual, assim, você saberá exatamente
quais os livros já leu, quer ler, está lendo, favoritos, desejados… etc. Além de funcionalidades para que você fique motivado em suas leituras, cumprindo metas, desafios, participando de ranking entre amigos… 
O Skoob também é a maior Rede Social para leitores em português, são mais de 10 milhões de pessoas escrevendo notas de leitura, fazendo avaliações, comentários e muitas recomendações. 
Algumas Funcionalidades: 
- Crie sua lista de leituras (lidos, estou lendo, quero ler, desejados, troco... etc) 
- Veja resenhas, avaliações e comente as atividades dos seus amigos. 
- Descubra e explore a lista de lançamentos das principais editoras. 
- Compartilhe notas e a progressão da sua leitura. 
- Encontre livros similares aos seus livros favoritos. 
- Crie uma meta de leitura para o ano.
- Barcode Scanner, para adicionar livros mais facilmente. 
- Descubra quanto tempo é necessário para terminar um livro 
- Desafios que incentivam a ler mais… 
ATENÇÃO: É importante lembrar que o Skoob NÃO é um leitor de Ebooks, com tantas funcionalidades é muito normal algumas pessoas pensarem assim. 
DIVIRTA-SE!! O Skoob é o melhor e mais completo aplicativo para quem deseja ler mais e organizar suas leituras.

bluejetty:00073166:ios.description:
Amazon Shopping offers app-only benefits to help make shopping on Amazon faster and easier. Browse, view product details, read reviews, and purchase millions of products. Amazon delivers to 100+ countries in as quickly as 3-5 days. Whether you’re buying gifts, reading reviews, tracking orders, scanning products, or just shopping, the Amazon Shopping app offers more benefits than shopping on Amazon via your desktop. 
Never miss a delivery
Get real-time tracking and delivery notifications so you know where your package is and when it arrives. 
Know exactly what you’re purchasing
Full 360° product view lets you see items from every angle. “View in you room” makes sure it fits by using your phone’s camera and VR so you can see it in your space. 
We’ll notify you when items go on sale
Just tap the heart icon to save items to Your Lists and we’ll alert you of price drops so you don’t miss a deal. 
Never forget your password
Save time by staying securely signed in. If you prefer to sign out, use facial or fingerprint identification to sign back in. 
Connect with us when it works best for you
Live chat support is open 24 hours, 7 days a week. Once you’ve started a chat, it stays that way for 24 hours so you don’t have to start your support session from the beginning. 
We’ll find that item for you
Not sure of an item’s brand or where to but it? Just tap the scan icon in the search bar, take a picture of the item or its barcode, and we’ll find it for you. 
In order to provide a rich experience and enable features such as voice shopping, notifications, visual search, customer reviews, and authentication this app may request permission to access contacts, camera, microphone, notification, touch id, photos and Bluetooth.
Amazon Shopping is available in English, Spanish, German, and Simplified Chinese. In addition to International Shopping, you can change your settings in this single app to shop Amazon.ca, Amazon.co.uk, Amazon.de, Amazon.fr, Amazon.com, Amazon.it, Amazon.es, Amazon.cn, Amazon.co.jp or Amazon.in.
For customers located within the European Union, United Kingdom or Brazil: By using this app, you agree to Amazon’s Conditions of Use applicable for your country. Please also see the applicable Privacy Notice, Cookies Notice and Interest-Based Ads Notice for your country. Links to these terms and notices can be found in the footer of your local Amazon homepage.
For all other customers: By using this app, you agree to the applicable Amazon Conditions of Use (e.g. www.amazon.com/conditionsofuse) and Privacy Notice (e.g. www.amazon.com/privacy) for your country. Links to these terms and notices can be found in the footer of your local Amazon homepage.
If your device supports TrueDepth technology, the app will use your device camera to detect your facial movements only while using certain features such as virtually try-on products like sunglasses. All information processed using this technology remains on your device and is not otherwise stored, processed or shared by Amazon.

bluejetty:00023482:ios.description:
Loyal Transportation is a transportation app booking service that enables you to get transport or airport transfer at your finger tips. Whether you travel anywhere in the Niagara region, Loyal Transportation is at your service. Book your first ride today!
The application works in St. Catharines (st kitts), Welland, Niagara Falls, Thorold, Ridgeway, Fort Erie, Stevensville, Chippawa, Port Dalhousie, Port Colborne, AS WELL AS in New Smyrna Beach and Daytona Beach, Florida. Hamilton, Toronto, Buffalo, Orlando, Daytona Beach airports are also covered when you book a Loyal T
How Loyal Transportation app works
- Simply confirm your pickup and destination point
- Get driver's car and vehicle information
- Tap to request a ride
- Track your travel progress in real-time on your way.
- Relax and enjoy your ride
Loyal Transportation: high technology
Once you have requested your ride or airport transfer, you can check the distance between you and your car driver, as well as your movements to the destination point on the map.
Loyal Transportation: safety
All our drivers are certified and have permits to take rides in both Canada and the US. We are focused on providing best-in-class transport in Niagara region to all our clients.
Loyal Transportation: other benefits:
- best transfer service in the US/Canada
- the possibility to estimate your rides
- quick car service - our smart algorithm always assigns the closest driver to pick you up, which saves a lot of time.
Loyal Transportation: advantages:
- You know the price of the trip before you book a vehicle. No surprises!
- Personalized service.
- Our drivers get excellent training.
- A wide fleet available in Niagara area.

bluejetty:00041604:ios.name: Lushair: Scalp & Hair Tracker
bluejetty:00041604:ios.summary:
Lushair works with the Lushair One and Lushair Pro scanners. Take close-up photos of your scalp at home and see how your scalp and hair change from one scan to the next.
SCAN AT HOME
Connect to your scanner over its own Wi-Fi and follow th
bluejetty:00041604:ios.description:
Lushair works with the Lushair One and Lushair Pro scanners. Take close-up photos of your scalp at home and see how your scalp and hair change from one scan to the next.
SCAN AT HOME
Connect to your scanner over its own Wi-Fi and follow the guide on screen. You scan five spots across your scalp: the front hairline, both temples, the part line and the crown. A Lushair One scan takes about two minutes. A Lushair Pro scan uses three kinds of light and takes about four.
SEE YOUR READINGS
Each scan gives you a hair score and readings for your scalp, your hair and your follicles: oil, flakes, redness, hair thickness, follicle density, hairs per follicle and white hair. Every reading comes with the photos it was read from and a short explanation in plain words.
TRACK CHANGE
Progress shows your score and each reading over time, so you can see what moved since your last scan.
FOLLOW A ROUTINE
Lushair builds a care routine from your scans and from what you tell it: the products you use, what works for you, what does not, and anything you are allergic to. Check off your steps each day and get a reminder when your next scan is due.
ASK
Ask questions about your scans and get answers based on your own readings. Ask uses a third-party AI service, and Lushair asks for your permission before your first question.
YOUR ACCOUNT
Sign in with a code sent to your email or your phone. There is no password to remember. You can delete your account, your scans and your photos from inside the app at any time.
WHAT YOU NEED
A Lushair One or Lushair Pro scanner, sold separately at lushair.ai. Lushair runs on iPhone and iPad.
PLEASE NOTE
Lushair is for cosmetic tracking and general wellness. It does not diagnose, treat or prevent any disease or condition, and it is not medical advice. Talk to a doctor about hair loss or any scalp problem, and before you start, stop or change any medicine.
Questions or feedback: support@lushair.ai

Privacy Policy: https://business.lushair.ai/privacy

bluejetty:00043883:ios.description:
SafeW是一款专为应对互联网办公中的网络威胁、确保企业通信数据安全而设计的即时通信应用工具。它全面支持iOS操作系统，基于数据加密技术，致力于提供纯净通信，帮助企业团队降低沟通和管理成本，提升办公效率和数据安全。
特点描述：
【私有化部署】：
用户可以将系统部署在企业自有服务器或我们官方云服务器上，确保用户信息、通信内容、文件等数据完全处于自主可控范围。
【无限网盘】：企业级网盘，收藏不限速，容量无限制，分类清晰明确；
【高强度加密】：
采用MTProto 2.0端到端加密方案，并在此基础上二次混淆加密，无惧黑客攻击，即便管理员也无法查看信息，确保通信安全。端到端的公钥加密方案，使用商用密认证高强度加密算法及国际加密算法。数据在传输过程中以密文形式存在，即便管理员也无法查看信息，确保通信安全。
【信息防泄漏，安全私密全面提升】：
提供远程销毁功能等多种防护模式，确保私密信息不外泄。
对话截图提醒：当用户对聊天内容进行截图时，系统会自动通知对方，让对方知道聊天内容被截图了。
群成员匿名聊天：群组中的成员可以匿名发表言论或参与讨论。这种功能通过隐藏成员的真实身份信息，提供了一层隐私保护，使得群成员的发言不与其个人身份直接关联。
副密码锁：两个密码登录都可以进入app，但是副密码看不到关键数据，这就意味着别人知道副密码之后依然考不到敏感数据，可以保护用户的数据安全；

bluejetty:00076070:ios.description:
Explore the new fairytale land after happy ending!
How's life going on after Princess married the Prince? Is it real that they live happily ever after?
Welcome to the world of Fairyscapes. Join Sophia to travel between real world and the fairytale land. While there, you'll meet Cinderella,Princess Snowy,Little Mermaid,Bella and other fairy characters. Help them to solve their problems in fairy world. 
Features:
- New Stories: Explore a new story after happy ending. Reveal Princess‘daily life in the fairy world.
-Treasures: Collect all kinds of supplies and magical items to keep your fairyland happy and prosperous.
- Explorations: Set on a mysterious adventure and explore the fairytale world: the enchanted Forest, the underwater Dungeon, the magic Palaze and many other fancy places in the fairyland. Save Fairytale land from unknown curse.
-Characters: Meet different fairytale characters - Cinderella,Snowy,Little Mermaid, Bella...... Help them solve daily problems. You can change their stories if you want!
-Chioces: Make different choices in the story.Experience the life of different fairy characters, all in one game!

-The account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period, and the renewal fee will be determined.
-After purchase, the subscription can be managed by the user, and automatic renewal can be turned off by going to the user's iTunes account settings.
-During the active subscription period, the current subscription cannot be canceled.
You can cancel the subscription through your iTunes account's subscription settings during the free trial period. This must be done 24 hours before the end of the subscription period to avoid charges. Please visit https://support.apple.com/HT202039 for more information.
-You can turn off the automatic renewal of the subscription through the iTunes account settings. However, you cannot cancel the current subscription during its active period.
-When a user purchases a subscription, any unused items from the free trial period will be taken back.

● 외장수리 | 견적 비교로 시작하세요
• 사고 사진 1장만 올리면 1시간 내 5개의 견적서가 도착해요.

Smart-ID allows you to give signatures equal to handwritten signatures (e
bluejetty:00061684:ios.description:
Smart-ID is the easiest, most convenient and safest way to authenticate yourself online – check your online bank account, access e-services and confirm transactions.
Smart-ID allows you to give signatures equal to handwritten signatures (except Basic level), which complies with EU regulations about qualified electronic signatures.
Smart-ID is currently available for:
- Estonian, Latvian, Lithuanian residents
- Estonian e-residents
- Belgium residents
EASY 
Get started by downloading Smart-ID app.
Follow the steps in the app to confirm your identity and complete the registration process. Once you’ve done that, you’re good to go – no other confirmation needed! 
CONVENIENT
Your Smart-ID is always within an easy reach!
You can use Smart-ID in as many smart devices as you want and gain access to your online accounts across all of them any time, any place. Using Smart-ID is free and totally unlimited.
SAFE
Smart-ID app does not store your identity or PIN codes. The app is used for key management: it creates your private keys while account registration and later mediates authentication and signature requests. User identity is managed securely by the service provider. A technology has been used in this product for which Cybernetica AS has filed a patent application or a patent has been granted.
Try out Smart-ID, visit portal.smart-id.com!

Immerse yourself in the world of classical music with STAGE+, the ultimate streaming experience from Deutsche Grammophon. Experience your favorite artists closer than ever before—live, in 4K, and with outstanding Dolby Atmos sound.

WHAT'S ON STAGE+
• Over 50 exclusive live streams per year from global cultural hotspots.
• A vast archive with thousands of video concerts and opera productions.
• Access to the entire catalog of Deutsche Grammophon, Decca, ECM, and Hyperion.
• Weekly new releases of audio and video content.
• Exclusive insights: interviews, documentaries, and behind-the-scenes footage.
STATE-OF-THE-ART TECHNOLOGY
We know classical music fans don't compromise. That's why we offer:
• 4K Video Quality: Crystal-clear images for an immersive experience.
• Hi-Res & Lossless Audio: Hear every detail in lossless quality.
• Dolby Atmos: Three-dimensional sound that puts you right in the middle of the action.
• Offline Mode: Download content to enjoy on a plane, train, or on vacation without an internet connection.
SPECIALIZED SEARCH & METADATA

• Composer (from Bach to Glass)
• Work & Opus
• Conductor & Orchestra
• Soloist & Instrument
• Era & Genre

SUBSCRIPTION DETAILS
Try STAGE+ now for 30 days free! After the trial period, enjoy monthly or yearly flexibility. The subscription renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
Bring the stage into your life—with STAGE+ Classical Music Live.
Supported formats: 4K, Dolby Atmos, Lossless Audio, Hi-Res.
Available on: iPhone, iPad, Apple TV, and Mac.
Terms & Conditions: https://www.stage-plus.tv/terms

bluejetty:00044913:ios.name: Moblo - 3D Furniture Modeling
bluejetty:00044913:ios.summary: Want to create a bespoke piece of furniture or design a space yourself? Moblo is the perfect 3D modeling tool for your future projects. Great for easily designing furniture in 3D, you can also use it to imagine more complex interior designs
bluejetty:00044913:ios.description:
Want to create a bespoke piece of furniture or design a space yourself? Moblo is the perfect 3D modeling tool for your future projects. Great for easily designing furniture in 3D, you can also use it to imagine more complex interior designs. Using augmented reality, you can quickly bring your ideas to life and visualize them in your own home.
Whether you're a beginner or an experienced 3D modeler, Moblo is the perfect 3D modeling tool for your bespoke furniture projects. With its interface designed for either a touchscreen or a mouse, Moblo is simple and accessible to everyone.
Examples of furniture or fittings often designed with Moblo: 
- Made-to-measure shelving 
- Bookcase 
- Dressing room 
- TV unit 
- Desk 
- Children's bed 
- Kitchen 
- Bedroom 
- Wooden furniture 
- Etc.
Visit our website or our Discord server to discover the full range of possibilities offered by Moblo. From DIY enthusiasts to professionals (carpenters, kitchen designers, interior designers, etc.), the community shares a whole host of ideas and creations.
www.moblo3d.app 
Creation steps:
1 - 3D modeling 
Assemble your future piece of furniture in 3D using an intuitive interface and ready-to-use parts (basic shapes/legs/handles). 
2 - Customize colors and materials
Choose which materials to apply to your 3D furniture from our library (paint, wood, metal, glass). Or create your own material using a simple editor. 
3 - Augmented reality 
Using your phone's camera, visualize your 3D creation in your own home and adjust it according to your space. This means you can see what your design looks like in a real-life context before you start production.
4 - 3D export
Export your project as a 3D mesh file (.stl or .obj) for use with other tools such as Sketchup or Blender (raw mesh, without colors or textures).
Main features:
- 3D assembly (movement/deformation/rotation).
- Duplicate/hide/lock one or more parts.
- Materials library (paint, wood, metal, glass, etc.).
- Custom materials editor (color, texture, shininess, reflection, opacity).
- Augmented reality visualization.
- Parts list.
- Notes related to parts.
- Photo capture.
Premium features:
- Possibility of working on several projects in parallel.
- Unlimited number of parts per project.
- Access to all part shapes.
- Access to all materials in the library.
- Save a selection as a new project.
- Import a project into an existing project.
- Export to .stl or .obj 3D mesh files (raw mesh without colors or textures).
- Export the parts list in .csv format (compatible with Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets).
- Share creations with other Moblo apps.
For further information, please visit our resources page on the moblo3d.app website.

bluejetty:00016322:ios.description:
Drumtune PRO turns your phone into a professional drum tuner trusted by tens of thousands of drummers worldwide. 
It helps you tune drums accurately, develop tuning skills, train your ears, and achieve the best possible sound for your kit.
〉〉Why do drummers choose Drumtune PRO?
• Gets your drums sounding their absolute best. Every time.
• Trains your ear through visual feedback and builds real tuning skills.
• Gives deep insights into drum tuning for true control and confidence.
• Packed with pro-level tools that help you stand out.
〉〉KEY FEATURES
DRUM TUNER
→ Tune snare, toms, floor toms, kicks, congas, and bongos with precision.
→ Focus lock-mode lets you clear lug pitches and kills overtones.
→ Shape your sound by balancing batter and resonant heads.
→ Lock in, optimize, and repeat your perfect tuning fast.
→ Save tuning presets to store your favorite sounds.
→ Save your personal tuning approach and custom pitches for batter, reso and fundamental per drum. Recall them in minutes, anywhere.
→ Download free Evans, Remo, and Aquarian drumhead packs to organize your presets.
LUG TUNER
→ Instantly spot which lugs need adjustment > no more guesswork.
DRUM KIT INTERVAL
→ Build drumkits. Adjust the tonal spacing between the individual drums. Create a coherent kit sound. 
→ Tweak the intervals between drums . Change the tuning of batter & reso with each drum stable in its tonal spot within the kit. Balance your kit for coherence in dynamics & feel.
PERCUSSION TUNER
→ Tune congas & bongos to any pitches or intervals within the set, accurately.
CLICK TRACK / METRONOME
→ Create custom beats, activate BPM count-in, control in-ear monitors, and tweak meters & subdivisions.
→ Use advanced training modes to tighten your groove & pocket.
→ Build, organize, and share tempo & rhythm track lists.

SAVE & RECALL EVERYTHING
→ Store exact tunings (including lug pitches and fundamental tone).

〉〉REAL TALK
Drumtune PRO isn’t about shortcuts.

Drumtune PRO is a tool to help you build lasting drum tuning skills with clear feedback, empowering you to make your own creative sound decisions.

⌘ Pro Tip ⌘
Drumtune PRO already has the widest tuning range of any drum tuner app or drum tuner device made so far. 
• High pitches beyond the tuning range can show as lower pitches within the tuning range. 
• Respect the natural tension range of your drumhead. Like tuning by ear, apply tension with care. 
• Use common sense & trust your drummer instinct to never overtighten. Too much tension can snap drumheads, especially thin snare reso heads. 
• Start at medium snare-reso tension first and increase gradually so the high pitch tracks accurately within range.
• When in doubt, or when overshooting the range chasing a pitch, return to medium tension.
► Tune smart, play hard, and trust Drumtune PRO to keep you sounding your best, every session!

bluejetty:00097835:ios.description:
"Secrets of Salem: Shadow of the Witch" – now free to play! Immerse yourself in a thrilling mystery adventure that blends hidden object games with unsolved mysteries games mechanics. Set in the dazzling yet treacherous streets of 1950s Salem, this supernatural tale follows Dakota, a young witch caught between life and death, as she embarks on a quest to find hidden objects, uncover dark secrets, and track down a ruthless killer. Can you help her unlock her powers, solve search and find games challenges, and reclaim her life before it’s too late?
Step into the dazzling streets of 1950s Salem, a city of towering lights and whispered spells, where glamour masks danger, and magic simmers beneath the surface of modernity. Dakota, the daughter of a Salem witch, returns to her hometown after receiving a mysterious letter about her mother’s death. Attacked by a shadowy figure, Dakota finds herself mortally wounded and trapped between the world of the living and the spirit realm. Guided by her mother’s friend Sebille, Dakota discovers her magical abilities and learns the killer is hunting witches across Salem. As a ghost, Dakota uncovers dark rituals, confronts vengeful spirits, and pieces together the attacker's identity. With her body lying in a hospital bed, her soul journeys into Salem’s most haunted places. Will Dakota harness her newfound powers, save her coven, and return to the living - or will she be consumed by the shadows?
· Hidden Object Gameplay!
Search through haunted mansions, eerie graveyards, and mystical apothecaries in thrilling hidden object games levels. Every scene is packed with interactive elements where you must find hidden objects to reveal hidden clues and solve Salem’s deepest secrets!
· Spellbinding Mini-Games!
Put your skills to the test with mystical riddles that unlock secrets and propel Dakota’s story forward. Tackle creative potion-brewing, memory-based spellcasting sequences, and intricate lock-picking games!
· Magic, Choices & Consequences!
Your decisions shape Dakota’s fate in this mystery adventure. Will you harness her powers wisely and uncover the truth, or fall into the darkness that threatens Salem? Every choice affects the story’s outcome, making each mystery hidden object games playthrough unique!
· Collectibles and Achievements!
Hunt for ancient amulets, spell tomes, and coven artifacts that enhance Dakota’s powers and reveal Salem’s haunted legacy. Earn achievements by solving mini-games flawlessly, uncovering rare items, and making key narrative choices!
Will you survive the hidden object games challenges and expose a sinister plot against witch coven? Play now for free!

bluejetty:00064506:ios.description:
smallcase is a great place to put your money to work. We have investment ideas across Indian Stocks & ETFs, Mutual Funds, Fixed Deposits, and for global diversification, US Stocks & ETFs.
What makes smallcase stand out from other investment apps is our ‘model portfolios’, also known as ‘smallcases’. These are baskets of Indian Stocks/ETFs, Mutual Funds or US Stocks/ETFs. These smallcases are created by investment experts around an idea like a trending sector (Defence, Pharma, etc.), a theme (AI & Data Centres, Clean Energy, etc.) or a trusted strategy (Momentum, Value & Growth, etc.)
To keep your investments fresh, these smallcases are periodically rebalanced by buy/sell recommendations of underlying stocks to keep up with market trends. 
INVEST IN INDIAN STOCKS & ETFs
- Connect your existing broking or demat account, or open a new one. smallcase supports India's top brokers including Kite by Zerodha, Groww, Upstox, ICICI Direct, HDFC Securities, IIFL Securities, Angel One, Motilal Oswal, Axis Direct, Kotak Securities, 5paisa, Alice Blue, Nuvama, and more
- Select an idea to invest in like Electric Mobility, and leave the underlying stock picking to experts. They will research across EV manufacturers, charging service providers, battery manufacturers, etc. to find the most suitable for the smallcase
- SIP into multiple stocks in one go
- Apply rebalance updates periodically to keep your investments fresh
INVEST IN US STOCKS & ETFs
- Open a free Global Investing Account and fund it via your Indian bank account
- Invest in trending ideas unique to US markets like AI Supply Chain, Robotics, Country Rotation, etc. Leave the underlying stock picking to experts.
- Since fractional shares are supported, start investing with just $50
- Your investments stay fresh with automated rebalancing when the smallcase manager triggers a buy/sell action of underlying stocks
- Invest with confidence via the GIFT City framework, fully compliant with Indian regulations
INVEST IN MUTUAL FUNDS
- Invest in baskets of direct mutual funds with zero commission
- Select an idea like Parking your Savings, Sector Rotation, Flexicap Picks, etc, and leave the selection of underlying mutual funds to experts
- SIP into multiple mutual funds at once
TRACK YOUR NET WORTH WITH WEALTH OFFICE
- Get a 360° view of your finances across stocks, mutual funds, gold, real estate, FDs, EPF, loans, and credit health
- Chat with Wealth Office AI to uncover insights about your wealth, forecast your net worth, and get roadmaps for your financial goals
GET LOAN AGAINST SECURITIES
- Get a loan against your stock and mutual fund investments, without selling them
- Avail low interest rates starting at 9.9% p.a.
- Repay at any time with no foreclosure charges
Tenure: 36 months
Maximum Annual Percentage Rate (APR): 13%
Registered Non-Banking Financial Company (NBFC) Lenders:
- DSP Finance Private Limited
- The South Indian Bank Limited

bluejetty:00084936:ios.summary:
Freedom to communicate on your own terms
For individuals and communities - private communication between family, friends, hobby groups, clubs, etc.

bluejetty:00084936:ios.description:
Freedom to communicate on your own terms
For individuals and communities - private communication between family, friends, hobby groups, clubs, etc. 
Element X gives you fast, secure and private instant messaging and video calls built on Matrix, the open standard for real-time communication. This is a free and open-source app maintained at https://github.com/element-hq/element-x-ios
Stay in touch with friends, family and communities with:
• Real time messaging & video calls
• Public rooms for open group communication
• Private rooms for closed group communication
• Rich messaging features: emoji reactions, replies, polls, pinned messages and more.
• Video calling while browsing messages.
• Interoperability with other Matrix-based apps such as FluffyChat, Cinny and many more.
Privacy-first
Unlike some other messengers from Big Tech companies, we don’t mine your data or monitor your communications.
Own your conversations
Choose where to host your data - from any public server (the largest free server is matrix.org, but there are plenty of others to choose from) to creating your own personal server and hosting it on your own domain. This ability to choose a server is a large part of what differentiates us from other real time communication apps. However you host, you have ownership; it’s your data. You’re not the product. You’re in control.
Communicate in real time, all the time
Use Element everywhere. Stay in touch wherever you are with fully synchronised message history across all your devices, including on the web at https://app.element.io 
Element X is our next-generation app
If you’re using the previous-generation Element Classic app, it’s time to try Element X! It’s faster, easier to use, and more powerful than the classic app. It’s better in every way and we’re adding new features all the time.

bluejetty:00024969:ios.summary: Learn math with the innovative Ahaaa Math app! Ahaaa Math is a fun, engaging app for mastering math skills through interactive, game-based lessons, offering a perfect balance of math and play. Practice counting, adding, subtracting, multip
bluejetty:00024969:ios.description:
Learn math with the innovative Ahaaa Math app! Ahaaa Math is a fun, engaging app for mastering math skills through interactive, game-based lessons, offering a perfect balance of math and play. Practice counting, adding, subtracting, multiplying, and dividing while building your number sense and problem-solving skills.
Designed by math experts and loved by millions of families in Asia, Ahaaa Math helps your child excel in math from PreK to Grade 5 with CCSS-aligned content and activities.
Whether your child is in preschool, kindergarten, or elementary school, our app adapts to their learning level, ensuring they are challenged and motivated. Our game-based approach makes math practice a natural part of playtime, helping kids build confidence and a love for learning math.
WHY AHAAA MATH?
Ahaaa Math offers the perfect balance of math and play.
- Truly Game-Based Design. Math is in every move, making learning feel like play. Kids solve math problems naturally while playing, no need to solve problems just to unlock items. They won't even notice they're learning!
- Immersive Experience. Using engaging storylines, music, and real-world scenarios to create a positive and focused learning environment, helping children become confident math learners.
Ahaaa Math works.
- Proven Method. Using the Singapore CPA (Concrete-Pictorial-Abstract) method to make math visible and hands-on, ensuring thorough understanding of math concepts. 
- Structured Learning. Learn-Practice-Quiz-Evaluate system guarantees each concept is mastered. Just 15 minutes a day for 4 weeks can show significant improvement in math skills.
- Engaging and Motivating: Ahaaa Math offers over 5000 CCSS-aligned games and activities, covering everything from basic counting to advanced arithmetic, shape recognition, telling time, and unit conversion. Engaging challenges and a leaderboard motivate kids to learn independently, making math fun and rewarding.
Track progress easily. 
- 13-level learning system adapts to each child’s age and ability, providing a customized learning path and trackable progress reports.
Trusted by millions. 
- Ahaaa Math has brought the joy of learning to over 5 million families in Asia.
Family-friendly use. 
- One account supports up to 3 devices, making it cost-effective for families with multiple children. 100% ad-free and KidSAFE certified 
AWARDS
- kidSAFE Certified
- Mom's Choice Awards Gold Recipient
- National Parenting Product Awards Winner
- Tillywig Toy Awards Winner
- Xiaomi App Store - Golden Mi Award
- Huawei App Store - Craftsmanship Award
- Vivo App Store - the Aurora Award
SUBSCRIPTION
Become a member for $8.99/month with a 3-day free trial, or $59.99/year with a 7-day free trial. Enjoy full access to our app, including unlimited content, immediate tutoring, and learning analyses.
- Pricing may vary by country. Your subscription will be charged through your iTunes account at purchase confirmation and will automatically renew 24 hours before the end of the current period unless auto-renewal is turned off.
- Manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal anytime in your iTunes account settings. No refunds for unused portions.
Term of Service: https://cdn.mathufo.com/static/docs/terms_en.html
Privacy Policy: https://cdn.mathufo.com/static/docs/mathup_privacy_en.html
CONTACT

EmojiSwap is the global emoji trading market. Trade rare emojis, play games, and build your collection. Here's how it works:
1. Spin to mint your collection of 5 emojis. Can you score a legendary?
2. Plug your collection into the arcade. Play games, climb the leaderboards, and earn EmojiCoin!
3. Trade up to get the emojis you love. Swap with friends or submit offers directly to the market, for anyone to accept.

On EmojiSwap, you don't just own emojis – you own unique, authentic, digital assets certified by our exchange. Each item's transaction history can be traced all the way back to its mint date, and all swaps are publicly recorded on our global ledger. We are continuing to open up new ways for users and developers to access our rich exchange data.
We're building the future of the emoji economy, a place where you can play, trade, chat and collect. If you're going to trade unicode assets, there's no better place than EmojiSwap.

bluejetty:00070260:ios.description:
A soul-searching adventure about life’s precious moments, broken dreams, and changed plans.
Entrenched in a beautifully sunkissed and handcrafted world, embark on a heartfelt journey interwoven with lighthearted and pressure-free puzzle solving. 
Immerse yourself in a visual narrative as you uncover, stories of the old man’s life told through beautiful vignettes of his memories. Interact with the serene, whimsical environment as you solve playful puzzles and shape the landscape around you, growing the hills to create the old man’s path forward.
Find yourself transported to a vibrant and wishful world as you immerse yourself in meditatively delightful gameplay and inquisitive, quiet puzzle solving. Explore life’s complexities through the old man’s eyes as you experience his heartache, regret, and hope.
Features:
- A powerful and emotional narrative told only through imagery
- Gorgeously whimsical landscapes with hand-drawn art and animations
- Handcrafted, pressure-free puzzles
- Unique landscape-shaping mechanic
- A compact game experience perfect for a wanderlust-evoking escape
- Original and emotionally compelling soundtrack by SCNTFC

Anime Cloud Z
Dive into the ultimate anime gaming experience — where your knowledge, memory, and luck come together in one beautiful cloud of fun.
Enjoy eight exciting mini-games inspired by your favorite anime worlds.
Quiz Game (اختبار الأنمي)
Guess anime from images with multiple-choice questions and a countdown timer. Celebrate your victories with confetti effects.
Memory Game (لعبة الذاكرة)
Flip and match anime character pairs through smooth animations and timed scoring challenges.

Word Search (البحث عن الكلمات)
Find hidden anime titles in every direction—horizontal, vertical, and diagonal swipes supported.
Lucky Spinner (عجلة الحظ)
Spin for prizes, multipliers, or bonus games. The luckiest anime fans climb the leaderboard fastest.

Smooth animations and transitions
Score tracking and leaderboards
Responsive design for all screen sizes
Full Arabic interface with proper RTL support

This is FLEETING JOURNEY, a stylish mystery caper adventure …
–
bluejetty:00000555:ios.description:
The Grenville Goose has VANISHED. A thief has hidden the statuette somewhere on board a luxury train, and only by cracking his clues can you track down the treasure in time.
This is FLEETING JOURNEY, a stylish mystery caper adventure …
–
FLEETING JOURNEY is the prequel episode to FLEETING MEMORY. Pithy, fun and packed with detail, this point-and-click caper places you in the role of legendary private investigator Enescu Fleet.
So hop aboard, shift the mind into overdrive and, most of all, enjoy the ride …
–
FEATURES
• stunning hand-drawn art
• a sprightly musical score
• puzzles, riddles and other dynamic brainteasers
• funny and insightful character interactions
• tons of debonair in-game comments
• a fluffy little dog who appreciates the occasional catnap
• a grumpy mayor
• a surprisingly valuable bird
• snazzy train decor
• AND Enescu Fleet, the world's greatest, semiretired detective
Step into his shoes today!

bluejetty:00071657:ios.description:
Satisfy your eyes & frustrated angry brain who had been sick and tired at home all the time with this oddly satisfying surprising series of games with easy & relaxing visuals! Try these most satisfying ASMR trigger based games with the best haptic feedback if you like to stack colors organize & tidy things up that will relax & satisfy your eyes with its smooth addictive game play following series of satisfying tasks including
Bubble Tea with Sweet Satisfaction:
Enjoy the ice blended Taiwanese popping bubbly boba drink shaken well with ice! Put in the bubbles add water to make them bigger turn them into chewy tapioca balls, add milk & blend it. Top it with cream & serve the ice blended frozen bubble tea just like slushy to the client for sweet satisfaction. Have your satisfaction with super fun addicting bubble tea simulator.
Satisfying ASMR Slicing Sand & everyday objects as cakes:
Forget soap cutting & enjoy ASMR slicing of kinetic sand & everyday object as cakes. Cut, slice & dice these everyday objects that look like cakes & sand sculptures using 1000 degree knife. Swipe to cut slice & dice into ASMR slices, Just press the knife & feel the device vibrate so nicely & smoothly that you will feel like cutting it in real. The best slicing simulator with smooth haptic feedback.
Stack Satisfying Pixel Cube Roller:
Love to fix the item & break them all? Drag pixel roller, stack colors & lay pixels in the right way that are messed all around! Once all the pixel cubes are in order crush cubes by tapping them with finger, make them see smashing, crushing & break'em all with real nice & soft vibrations for some amazing ASMR triggers.
Massage The Slime Man:
Massage the tired man for ultimate relaxation. Trust me his back is just like slime simulator. You will feel like pressing, poking a slime while massaging him. Why not give it a try & try not to say wow!
Idle Factory Conveyor Belt Sort Sport:
Enjoy this sort sport & Collect the rotten items from the conveyor belt of the factory. Collect all the right items in the right time to finish. Oddly satisfying process for fun!
Match 3D Item – Matching Puzzle with tricky brain test:
test your brain & Match similar 3d objects in given time! Simple yet challenging game for all groups. Match various pairs of well polished & perfectly designed objects in time. The best matching puzzle with simplicity & smoothness is here.
Perfect Fit it 3D:
Perfect Fit for the right place. Fit'em all with smooth press ! Insert the metal pieces that will fit perfectly into the metal block. Press the piece when it is at the right place & fit shapes. When it is fitting inside your device will vibrate slowly gently with its haptic sensors for an ASMR trigger & it will be done so smoothly that you wont be able to resist not saying Wow.

bluejetty:00023154:ios.description:
Ora Weather Radar tells you what the weather means for you, not just what it is: what to wear, when the rain starts, whether your plans hold. Live radar shows rain moving toward you, with timing for the next 15 minutes so you know whether to wait it out. And when severe weather moves in, Ora tells you what's happening, what to do, and when it's over.
What you get for free:
* A clear daily forecast, tailored to your location
* Live weather radar to see rain as it moves toward you
* A 7-day forecast to plan the days ahead
* Governmental advisories from NOAA
* Rain timing for the next 15 minutes, so you know whether to wait it out
* Evening report with tomorrow's forecast
Get the full picture with OraPlus:
* Full precipitation radar, minute by minute, up to 12 hours ahead
* A 14-day forecast, hour by hour, for planning you can trust
* Hurricane tracker with the full storm path
* Storm cells, lightning, and detailed wind maps
* Morning and evening reports for every location you care about
* All custom notifications
* Wildfires on the radar map
* No ads, ever
Ora Weather Radar works on iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch, with home screen widgets that keep the forecast one glance away.
Feel ready. Every day.
OraPlus is an auto-renewing subscription, available weekly (with a 3-day free trial) or yearly. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at purchase and renews automatically unless turned off at least 24 hours before the period ends. Manage or cancel anytime in your Apple Account settings. Prices are shown in the app.
Terms & Conditions: https://impalastudios.com/terms 
Privacy Policy: https://impalastudios.com/privacy
