Ora Weather Radar tells you what the weather means for you, not just what it is: what to wear, when the rain starts, whether your plans hold. Live radar shows rain moving toward you, with timing for the next 15 minutes so you know whether to wait it out. And when severe weather moves in, Ora tells you what's happening, what to do, and when it's over.

What you get for free:

* A clear daily forecast, tailored to your location
* Live weather radar to see rain as it moves toward you
* A 7-day forecast to plan the days ahead
* Governmental advisories from NOAA
* Rain timing for the next 15 minutes, so you know whether to wait it out
* Evening report with tomorrow's forecast

Get the full picture with OraPlus:

* Full precipitation radar, minute by minute, up to 12 hours ahead
* A 14-day forecast, hour by hour, for planning you can trust
* Hurricane tracker with the full storm path
* Storm cells, lightning, and detailed wind maps
* Morning and evening reports for every location you care about
* All custom notifications
* Wildfires on the radar map
* No ads, ever

Ora Weather Radar works on iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch, with home screen widgets that keep the forecast one glance away.

Feel ready. Every day.

OraPlus is an auto-renewing subscription, available weekly (with a 3-day free trial) or yearly. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at purchase and renews automatically unless turned off at least 24 hours before the period ends. Manage or cancel anytime in your Apple Account settings. Prices are shown in the app.

Terms & Conditions: https://impalastudios.com/terms 
Privacy Policy: https://impalastudios.com/privacy

Need help or want to share feedback? Email us anytime at support@impalastudios.com

bluejetty:00037788:ios.description:
Listen to the radio stations you love with the official app from the radio industry.
Download Radioplayer FREE today and start your listening experience! 
- No registration required 
- Free 
- High-Quality Sound 
- Available on all your devices with Bluetooth, Airplay, CarPlay, Apple Watch, Smart Device Link
- Personalised content recommendations based on your preferences
New: 
- Easy access: Listen to your favourites directly from the homepage 
- Continuous listening: switch between devices without missing a beat. 
- Sync your favourites between mobile and Smart TV.
- Sync your favourites between your different smartphones.
HOW DOES IT WORK? 
1/ Select your country 
2/ Choose your favourite radio stations & podcasts
3/ Choose your city to get local radio suggestions
Enjoy easy access to your favourites & recently listened content directly on the homepage.
INTUITIVE AND EASY 
It’s easy to use and with some powerful features which will help you enjoy radio even more:
- Personalised recommendations based on your preferences 
- Ultimate search function to help you discover new radio stations and podcasts
- Download podcasts for offline listening 
- Notifications to remind you about new episodes of your favourite shows and podcasts
- Alarm Clock: Wake up to your favourite radio station
- Sleep Timer: Fall asleep to the music your love
- Find the names of the songs and artists currently playing on your favourite radio station
CAR LISTENING: 
- Voice control to skip safely through your favourite radio stations while driving
- Great Apple CarPlay support and ‘Wrong Way Driver’ technology to alert you to motorway dangers
- Easy Mode for playing your favourites with one tap
SEAMLESS LISTENING
Enjoy smooth and uninterrupted transition between devices.
It means that you for example can start listening on the phone without pausing, and then switch the listening to your Smart TV without any disruption. 
HIGH-QUALITY SOUND 
Enjoy crystal-clear audio, optimised for both mobile data and speakers. We use HQ streams direct from broadcasters, which other apps can’t access.
On the go, Radioplayer switches to mobile-friendly streams to reduce your data consumption.
FOLLOW NEWS AND SPORTS LIVE 
Stay informed with live news 24/7 and sports events. 
Listen to the most recongised voices in your country and also all the local content that is relevant to you. 
LISTEN TO MUSIC 
With our musical radios, listen to the best rap, pop, rock, R&B, indie, dance,electro, classical, and jazz hits…
BROADEN YOUR HORIZONS 
Explore a genre of radio stations and podcasts with searches by themes: Kids, Business, Entertainment, World Music, Religion and many more
Radioplayer Worldwide, Ltd. is a not-for-profit company, aimed at making radio listening easier in connected devices, operating in 22 countries: Austria, Belgium, Canada, Croatia, Cyprus, Denmark, Estonia, Finland, France, Germany, Greece, Ireland, Italy, Norway, Liechtenstein, Luxembourg, Slovenia, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, The Netherlands, United Kingdom
A SUGGESTION 
Do you like Radioplayer? Support us by leaving us a review
Do not hesitate to send us your suggestions for making Radioplayer even better!
For more information, Radioplayer.org

bluejetty:00087597:ios.summary: Time to sweat at home, have an absolute blast, and reach your fitness goals with the Boxing & Bubbles APP by Fitness Pro Christa DiPaolo! If you're ready for a strong mind, knockout body, supportive squad, and a ton of fun, Christa's B&B pr
bluejetty:00087597:ios.description:
Time to sweat at home, have an absolute blast, and reach your fitness goals with the Boxing & Bubbles APP by Fitness Pro Christa DiPaolo! If you're ready for a strong mind, knockout body, supportive squad, and a ton of fun, Christa's B&B program is just for YOU. Join the global community for unlimited access to HUNDREDS of real-time workouts for every fitness level, including strength training, jump rope, kettlebells, upper body, lower body, mobility, core, guest instructors, and so much more! New real-time sweat sessions and a suggested training schedule added WEEKLY. 
Christa's unique approach to fitness results in authentic, relatable, engaging, fun, and challenging workouts that leave you feeling empowered, inspired, and motivated. Here at B&B, we don't talk about weight loss; it's about how the workouts make you FEEL. The Boxing & Bubbles Program allows you to design an individualized fitness regimen based on your lifestyle. From 10-60 minute, cued, follow-along videos, customize your exclusive playlist to suit your workout needs. Sweat with Christa in beautiful Miami Beach and get ready to feel strong and more confident from the inside out. Working out has never been this much fun! 
B&B MEMBERSHIP FEATURES: 
• Access to hundreds of workouts filmed in beautiful Miami Beach for every goal and fitness level. 
• Full-length, follow-along videos including boxing, kickboxing, strength training, cardio, jump rope, kettlebells, upper body, lower body, core, body weight, mobility, guest instructors, and so much more! 
• Choose from 14 unique workout categories to keep you motivated. 
• New fully guided sweat sesh's from beginner, intermediate, and advanced are uploaded weekly, along with a suggested training schedule.
• Ninja notes so you can privately make comments on your workouts. 
• Custom drag-and-drop playlist feature to curate a unique workout adventure.
• Filter your sweat sesh between categories, intensity, duration, body part, and equipment. 
• Upload private images to track your progress. 
• Cast or stream to any device from anywhere in the world. 
• Download videos to watch offline. 
• Interact with the B&B community in the comments section under every video.
All new members get exclusive access to a 7-day free trial! 
ABOUT YOUR TRAINER: 
Christa has dedicated her life to fitness after her dreams of a professional boxing career were sidelined due to herniated discs in her cervical spine. Her injury has made her highly compassionate to anyone with pre-existing injuries and conscientious about teaching proper form and technique. 
Christa has appeared on Good Morning America, The Today Show, and PopSugar Fitness and was featured in magazines such as Well + Good, Vogue.com, Glamour.com, US Weekly, Women's Health, and Shape. She has multiple certifications with the National Academy of Sports Medicine, including, Performance Enhancement Specialist, Group Personal Training Specialist, and Certified Personal Trainer. Her most outstanding achievement, though, is working out with you in your home on the B&B APP! 
Terms of Use (EULA):
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/ 
Email us anytime! 
support@christadipaolo.com

bluejetty:00061101:ios.description:
Your own ecommerce store is just a few taps away. Create, promote, and manage your online store right in the Ecwid by Lightspeed mobile app, and build your business from the palm of your hand.
LAUNCH YOUR OWN ECOMMERCE BUSINESS
- Design your ecommerce website right from your mobile device — no coding required
- Add products with a snap of your camera
- Choose from 60+ secure payment options, like PayPal, Stripe, Square, Chase, and more
- Set up shipping, delivery, or self pickup options for your customers
SELL EVERYWHERE
- Sell directly on your website
- Import your Ecwid by Lightspeed store to Facebook with the tap of a finger to Sell on Facebook
- Sell on Instagram by tagging products in your posts with shoppable tags
- Add products to Amazon and eBay
- Or turn your online storefront into a mobile app (via the web Control Panel)
NEVER MISS AN ORDER
- Get push notifications about new orders
- Process orders update order statuses, and keep customers up-to-date automatically
- Add order notes for staff
- Add tracking numbers to orders and notify customers about changes
- Create and manage orders or quickly find and edit order details
- Contact customers directly from the app
KEEP YOUR INVENTORY UP-TO-DATE
- View and manage products on-the-go
- Update product options like size, color, and more
- Edit prices at will
- Control stock levels and change product availability
MARKET YOUR BUSINESS
- Build marketing campaigns
- Create and share discount coupons
- Increase sales by recovering abandoned carts
- Set-up free shipping based on order value to encourage customers to spend more
- Track everything from your Ecwid Control Panel
GET HELP WHEN YOU NEED IT
- Chat with our expert customer support team right from your mobile device
- Get free ecommerce tips delivered right to your inbox every week from the Ecwid team
PRICING
Choose the right Ecwid by Lightspeed plan for your business:
FREE
Easy online store to launch your business for free:
- A shopping cart with everything you need to start accepting orders online
- Storefront with up to 5 products
- Email support
VENTURE
Professional features to grow and manage your online store:
- List up to 100 products
- Reach customers on Instagram/Facebook
- Promote your store with discount coupons
- Offer scheduled order pickup (perfect for restaurants)
- Email and Chat support
BUSINESS
Advanced ecommerce solutions to expand your business:
- List up to 2,500 items
- Grow sales with automated email reminders to shoppers who abandon their carts
- Connect your store to Mailchimp to create powerful email campaigns
- Set-up staff permissions to manage your store
- Enable multilingual storefront to sell internationally
- Email, Chat, and Phone support
UNLIMITED
Everything you need to sell online, with mobile, and in-person:
- Unlimited product listings
- 12 hours of custom development to build unique solutions for your store
- Priority support by email, chat, or phone.
By signing up, you agree to the Terms of Service: https://www.lightspeedhq.com/legal/lightspeed-service-agreement/ and Privacy Policy: https://www.lightspeedhq.com/legal/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00016038:ios.description:
Beckett Media provides products and services to help collectors and businesses buy, sell, protect, value, and learn about sports and non-sports trading cards and collectibles. 
Beckett Online Price Guide (OPG)
OPG subscription provides instant and 24/7 access to over 7 million sports card listings that are updated daily PLUS FREE access to Organize. If you already have an OPG subscription, no additional purchase is required.
Beckett Grading Services(BGS)
• Population Report: See exact counts of cards graded previously by BGS.
• Serial Number Lookup: Verify your certification number, card grades & subgrades.
• My Orders: Check status of your order, tracking information & grades received.
• FAQs:Frequently asked questions about grading submissions.
Beckett Authentication Services (BAS)
• Signature Review: Upload your own image or provide link for a quick review of an autograph to find out if it is likely to pass authentication or not. Customers get a non-binding opinion within an estimated time of 24-48 hours. $10 fee for signature review is charged regardless of the outcome of results received. Refund will be issued only in case we are unable to render an opinion. No refund or cancellation if turnaround time exceeds 24-48 hours.
• Verify Certificate: Verify your certification number with information on signer, item type, additional notes, grades & images.
• Pricing: Check authentication fee by searching by a signer’s name.
• My Orders: Check order status, tracking information & item results.
• Services: Information on all services offered by BAS.
Organize
Create & manage your collections, including graded cards, plus view Beckett Value when you have an OPG subscription.
Section for In-App Purchases
Subscribe to below from our app.
Single Sport OPG: Access price guide for your preferred sport though web as well as iOS-iPhone and iPad.
Total Access: Get access to all sports OPG through web & iOS-iPhone & iPad. Additionally, you get access to Market Data Report (MDR) through web.
Vintage (all sports): Includes Web Access and iOS access through iPhone and iPad.
This is a free app download & does not include free subscription. Subscription can be purchased within the app.
When a recurring subscription is purchased, content will be provided immediately.
Subscriptions available for Single Sport:
1 month - $14.99
3 months - $40.99
6 months - $74.99
12 months - $129.99
Total Access:
1 month - $40.99
3 months - $119.99
6 months - $199.99
12 months - $349.99
Organize:
1 month - $6.99
12 months - $64.99
Player:
1 month - $4.99
- No trial period for above subscriptions.
- Subscription will renew automatically unless cancelled more than 24 hours before the end of the current period. You will be charged for renewal within 24 hours of the end of the current period, for same duration and at the current subscription rate for the product.
-You can choose a different subscription offering through your Account Settings or tap Cancel Subscription to cancel your subscription. If you cancel, your subscription will stop at end of the current billing cycle.
-Payment will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase.
- All Subscriptions are set to auto-renew except player. 
- Online Subscriptions are non-refundable. Please review your order carefully before completing your purchase.
To purchase subscription, search any term at “Home” or browse through “OPG” tab. Click on “Buy Pricing” under-pricing & you will be redirected to subscription page related to sport/term.
In case of any issues, please write to us at customerservice@beckett.com
Check our privacy policy here:
https://www.beckett.com/privacy
You can find our terms & conditions here:
https://www.beckett.com/tos
When you click on links to various merchants on this site and make a purchase, this can result in this site earning a commission. Affiliate programs & affiliations include, but are not limited to, the eBay Partner Network.

bluejetty:00078171:ios.name: memoryOS: Memory Games
bluejetty:00078171:ios.summary: memoryOS contains interactive bite-sized lessons by a 2X World Memory Champion and an educational 3D game of Virtual Mind Palaces - all in one easy-to-use app. It utilizes scientifically proven memory techniques, spaced repetition and paten
bluejetty:00078171:ios.description:
memoryOS contains interactive bite-sized lessons by a 2X World Memory Champion and an educational 3D game of Virtual Mind Palaces - all in one easy-to-use app. It utilizes scientifically proven memory techniques, spaced repetition and patented game mechanics to enhance long-term memory storage and improve knowledge retention.
memoryOS is loved by 500,000+ people worldwide because it is a whole new, joyful & game-changing tool for obtaining the most effective memorization skills.
Co-founded by Jonas von Essen, who went from struggling to remember to becoming a World Memory Champion, winning on Who Wants To Be a Millionaire, "Jeopardy, and setting a world record by memorizing 100,000 decimals of Pi . 
memoryOS app has over 18k public worldwide ratings on Apple and Google app stores combined, averaging 4.8 stars. Users also continue adding 5-star reviews daily, sharing how effective and life-changing memoryOS has been for them. Also, memoryOS remains the most crowdfunded app in Kickstarter’s history.
Memorization is as important as reading and writing and should be taught as our base skill. Our mission is to enable millions of people to remember needed information easily.
With memoryOS, you will learn how to memorize:
- Names, Long speeches, Lists of items, Birthdays, Personal facts, Passwords, Trivia, Languages, Vocabulary and phrases, Countries and Capitals, Flags, Historical timeline, Numbers, Periodic table
- Content of complete books, Dates of significant events, Complex data structures, Concepts, and figures
- Art, Anatomy, Decks of cards, Advanced number systems; Long sequences of numbers, Binary Digits
You will also learn:
- How to keep track of years, months, weeks, and days 
- Advanced study techniques, Spaced Repetition system, Speed memorization
Why did Google Brands Accelerator recognize memoryOS as being 'Light Years Ahead' in the memory space?
• memoryOS delivers results:
During our pre-launch phase, thousands of users completed our demo and, on average, had a 70% increase in recall and a 60% increase in recall speed just after the first ~40min session.
• Providing your mind with structured storage space:
We have spent tens of thousands of hours creating and optimizing our Virtual Mind Palaces, so you don’t have to spend months constructing your own the hard way. These virtual palaces serve as blueprints for your mind's storage space, allowing you to easily encode, store and recall like a memory champion.
• A proven innovative approach that works:
During our research and development stage, thousands of people of all age groups and even those with difficult medical conditions found memoryOS as an effective and useful tool. Actual results exceeded our team’s expectations.
• Gamified edtech at its best:
memoryOS has proven to work on people with no prior gaming experience - anyone can use it. Utilizing the power of the Unity game engine, memoryOS is widely accessible on all mobile and tablet devices and is soon coming to VR.
--
Joining memoryOS is free. This provides extensive value on the free plan, and you are not obligated to pay to start using it. You can subscribe to a Student Premium plan for as low as $3.49/month when billed annually or $4.99/month when billed monthly (it can be 10-20% higher in some countries due to local taxes). You can subscribe through the 'Shop' section of the memoryOS app and find the above-mentioned or go to your App Store app's profile and choose a desired plan there. Recurring payments will automatically renew unless you cancel your account at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period. You can manage your subscription, cancel anytime, or turn off auto-renewal by accessing your iTunes account.
Join the memoryOS community of over 500,000+ early adopters who share this memorable journey!
--

* Provides a large number of free VPN servers with optional locations.

 --------Features-------- 
* Free
* Servers grouped by countries, So you can select the country you want to connect easily.
 --------User Guide-------- 
OvpnSpider will automatically search for free VPN servers on the Internet; and the result is provided as an OpenVPN profile which is categorized by countries. 
User can connect to the VPN server in-app directly.
-- Clicking the selected server on the list will connect to vpn server automatically.
===============================================
User also can export OpenVPN Profile .ovpn to other Applications.
--Clicking the share icon on the list will launch a popup view of the available applications. 
-- If OpenVPN (the 'openvpn connect' application is already installed) is selected, the profile will be automatically imported into OpenVPN and then the user could connect to the VPN server.
-- If Mail is selected, the OpenVPN Profile .ovpn will be automatically inserted into the email as an attachment. and the user can share the OpenVPN profile files to other devices or other users through the email. Thus other equipments which have already installed the OpenVPN application, could use the profile to connect to VPN server.

bluejetty:00014914:ios.description:
Discover Zoom Zoom, an incredibly efficient transportation app that offers private cars with highly qualified drivers, who guarantee a secure journey with a superior quality of service. With just a few minutes’ wait, you’ll have a car and driver ready to take you wherever you wish to go.
So how does Zoom Zoom work?
1. Start by ordering or reserving your journey. All you need to do is open the app and let us know your current location and your desired destination. Choose from our various vehicle types – ZoomGo, ZoomSUV, ZoomLuxury, and more – and explore the options available in your city!
2. Then, simply confirm your journey and your driver will be on their way. We will provide you with your driver's name and your vehicle's information, such as its license plate and the distance of arrival.
3. We will also inform you of the estimated price of the ride before you travel , which you can pay with credit or debit cards, cash, or any other payment method that you find suitable.
4. Moreover, you can also share the details of your journey with family or friends so that they can track your whereabouts for additional safety.
In the Zoom Zoom app, you have the opportunity to personalize your journey. Select your preferred music, take advantage of the opportunity for female drivers to specify a preference to accept trip requests only from female passengers, or decide how many seats are necessary for an enjoyable trip.
Where is Zoom Zoom available?
Zoom Zoom is offered in more than 25 cities across the United States and Canada. You can check out the full list of cities where the app operates on zoom.cab.
So, what are the advantages of the Zoom Zoom app?
For one, your safety is always our priority. Every journey is tracked and can be instantly shared with someone you trust so that they always know where you are. 
Furthermore, signing in is simple and convenient, as you can use your email address and password. 
You also have the option to save your most frequently visited locations by clicking the ‘heart’ icon located at the right-hand side of the search bar. 
Additionally, our drivers have all undergone a very selective onboarding process, ensuring they provide the best service possible.
And finally, you can use one single account to travel in multiple cities, which is ideal for those who love to travel!
Do you want to be a driver with Zoom Zoom?
If you’re passionate about helping others explore their city, join the fleet of Zoom Zoom drivers! Start to earn money with the help of an app that values your safety and provides you with the best fares. For more information, go to zoom.cab/drivers or download the Zoom Zoom Drivers app.
Are you looking for corporate transportation options for your business?
Then look no further! Our corporate service offers your business an expansive fleet of cars to meet all of your company's requirements. Plus, you can use our management platform to easily monitor your employees’ expenses and journeys. Learn more by visiting zoom.cab.

bluejetty:00062605:ios.name: Proverbs & Psalms - King James
bluejetty:00062605:ios.summary: The book of Proverbs and Psalm contains unique contents among the books in the Old Testament. Both widely read and highly treasured books of the Old Testament, the book of Proverbs and Psalm contain wise sayings, songs of praises, encourage
bluejetty:00062605:ios.description:
The book of Proverbs and Psalm contains unique contents among the books in the Old Testament. Both widely read and highly treasured books of the Old Testament, the book of Proverbs and Psalm contain wise sayings, songs of praises, encouragements, and prayers of the Jewish people.
The chapters of the book of Proverbs are divided into three parts:
• Chapter 1 – 9 is addressed to the youth and Solomon writes on how to acquire wisdom through listening to your parent’s advice and on following a godly path.
• Chapter 10 – 24 shows the contrast between a wise person and foolish person, between good and evil which is addressed to generally all people seeking wisdom and a godly lifestyle. 
• Chapter 25 – 31 is addressed for leaders regarding wisdom, warnings and instructions that would benefit in leading people to a godly lifestyle.
While the chapters of the book of Psalms are divided into five parts:
• Psalm 1 – 41 is about the matters of human life, personal connection between man and God
• Psalm 42 – 72 is about the matters of the Israelites and their relationship with God.
• Psalm 73 – 89 is about God’s law and sanctuary.
• Psalm 90 – 106 is about the nation of Israel and all other nations.
• Psalm 107 – 150 is about the Word of God and the matters of His heart.
The book of Proverbs is written mainly by King Solomon, displaying God’s wisdom in his life but there are also others writers such as Lemuel and Agur while the book of Psalm is mostly written by King David, the father of Solomon and also other writers such as the sons of Korah, to Asaph, to Solomon and Moses.
The book of Proverbs and Psalm both have different purpose but both books teaches, instructs, inspires, and guides the readers to a godly lifestyle, to a knowledge of God’s heart and His character, and to life’s perspectives that pleases the Lord. 
The book of Proverbs teaches the readers and believers about godly wisdom and lifestyle with the foundation of the fear of the Lord (see Prov. 9:10) while the book of Psalm reveals to the readers and believers about the heart of God, the cry of the Israelites, prophecies about Jesus Christ and encouragements with prayers in times of troubles, sorrows, sufferings and trials.
Both Psalm and Proverbs have unique voice and style but both its purpose is for believers to grow in wisdom, knowledge and a closer relationship with God.

bluejetty:00015947:ios.description:
Acrostic puzzles are crosswords with a twist: find the hidden quote. This combination of crossword and cryptogram provides an entertaining brain workout. Each letter in the quote is linked to a letter in one of the clue answers. As you fill in more and more answers, more letters will begin to fill the quote grid, until eventually the entire quote is revealed. Once the quote is partially filled in, you can also do this process in reverse – each letter you add to the quote will fill in the corresponding letter in the clue answers. By working back-and-forth, eventually the entire quote and all clue answers will be revealed.
The app includes 60 free quality puzzles with no ads, ever. They range from beginner to expert from renowned publishers like Acrostica, Acrostics by Cyn, Lovatts Puzzles, PennyPress Anacrostics, Puzzle Baron and Spanish language puzzles from Tav Ripo. Additional puzzle packs containing 48 to 50 puzzles are available for a small fee; the full library is 7100 puzzles!
Advanced play features include automatic grid updating and indexing, see related cells, multi-level undo, remove errors, and hints. A wide range of difficulty levels will challenge beginners and seasoned players alike.
If you like word games, crosswords or cryptograms, acrostic puzzles are a fun way to exercise your brain!
Quality Software by Egghead Games. Contact us at support@eggheadgames.com or www.eggheadgames.com. We stand by our products and will happily refund your purchase if you’re not completely happy.

Health + Fitness app created by Kylie Ross.
HEALTHiES was created to provide weekly workouts that are easy to follow, easily accessible, and will elevate your health and fitness! You’ll also have access to healthy recipes that are quick and easy to follow! HEALTHies integrates with the Health app to add your health stats to your workout log.
HEALTHiES is for anyone and everyone who is looking for workouts to kickstart their passion for working out and living a healthy lifestyle! 
THE WORKOUTS
in HEALTHiES you’ll get new lift workouts, hiit workouts, treadmill running workouts, and ab workouts every week. 
HiiT workouts are formatted in a circuit style with a suggested number of rounds to complete (feel free to adjust rounds to your physical fitness level).
These workouts are aimed to increase explosiveness and athletic performance.
LiFT workouts are formatted in a sets x reps style. these workouts are aimed to build lean muscle and increase strength.
THE RECIPES 
You’ll also have access to macro friendly, healthy meal, snack, and smoothie recipes. All recipes are single serving and have calorie and macros amounts available. 
THE GROCERY LIST
HEALTHiES customizable grocery list allows you to create your own grocery list and categorize your items to make grocery shopping fun and easy.
$12.99 billed monthly or $100.00 billed annually.
HEALTHiES™ content is owned by Kylie Ross.

bluejetty:00084100:ios.description:
Welcome to Waifu AI Chat
Your AI-powered anime companion where every character has a unique personality, evolving memories, and a conversation style that's truly their own.
Whether you're seeking friendship, romance, creative roleplay, or simply someone to talk to, Waifu AI Chat lets you build meaningful connections with hand-crafted anime-inspired companions who remember your conversations and grow alongside you.
Features
• Hand-Crafted Characters
Chat with carefully designed AI companions, each with a distinct personality, backstory, interests, and communication style.
• Persistent Memory
Your companion remembers past conversations, shared moments, your preferences, and personal details—building a relationship that deepens over time.
• Interactive Storytelling
Dive into branching narrative adventures where your choices shape the story and lead to unique endings.
• AI-Generated Images
Share photos and receive AI-generated companion images tailored to the conversation.
• Rich Roleplay
Companions naturally adopt outfits, settings, moods, and actions, creating immersive and dynamic roleplay experiences.
• Karma & Streak System
Earn rewards for daily engagement, maintain conversation streaks, and unlock higher daily limits as your bond grows.
• Personalized Experience
Companions adapt to your communication style, learn your interests, and tailor their responses to create a truly personal connection.
• Send Gifts
Express appreciation with in-chat gifts that strengthen your companion's affection.
• Cross-Character Profiles
Your preferences and personality carry across characters, allowing every new companion to understand you from the very first conversation.
• Private & Secure
Your conversations are private and encrypted. Your data stays yours.
Why Waifu AI Chat?
Your companion learns from every interaction. They remember your favorite topics, recognize shared experiences, adapt their tone to match the moment, and evolve their personality as your relationship grows. Every conversation feels more personal over time.
Whether you're an anime fan looking for your favorite character archetype, a creative storyteller seeking a collaborative partner, or simply want a companion who genuinely pays attention, Waifu AI Chat delivers conversations that feel engaging, personal, and memorable.
Download Waifu AI Chat today and meet your perfect companion.
Disclaimer : Some features of the app are free to use. Some features of the app needs a premium subscription or an in app purchase. Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period. You can manage or cancel your subscription at any time from your App Store account settings.
Privacy Policy : https://sites.google.com/view/waifupp
Terms & Conditions : https://sites.google.com/view/waifu-tou/home

Lalamove – 24/7 On-Demand Delivery App
Need something delivered fast? Lalamove instantly connects you with a vast network of driver partners for fast, simple, and affordable deliveries anytime, anywhere. Founded in Hong Kong in 2013, we now serve 14 markets across Asia, Latin America, and EMEA, empowering businesses and individuals with hassle-free logistics. 
Fast and 24/7 Delivery Service
Get matched with a driver fast, any time of day or night. From urgent deliveries to scheduled business shipments, we're here 24/7 with on-demand, same-day, next-day, and scheduled options. Need multiple stops? We're here for your delivery needs. bluejetty:00082376:ios.description:
ADHDFlow helps quiet mental noise with ADHD-friendly soundscapes, app blocking, and personal listening insights. Whether you want to stop doomscrolling, get into deep work, study longer, calm down, or fall asleep more easily, ADHDFlow gives your mind a steadier place to land.
Choose your goal: Sleep, Deep Focus, Calm Down, Study, or Work. ADHDFlow refreshes your recommendations around what you need right now, from gentle sleep sounds to steady color noise, rain, fan hums, binaural-style tones, and relaxing nature blends.
ADHD-FRIENDLY SOUNDSCAPES
Explore soundscapes made to help you settle, focus, and unwind:
* Brown noise, green noise, pink noise, and white noise
* Rain, thunder, ocean waves, forest creek, city night, and fan sounds
* ADHD Frequency and binaural-style sound options
* Calm ADHD Brain, Work in Deep Focus, Soft Pink Noise, 2 Hz Binaural Beats, and more
* Recently Played and Favorites for fast access
BLOCK DISTRACTING APPS
ADHDFlow can help protect your focus session from distracting apps. Choose which apps stay allowed, then turn on Block Apps while you work, study, relax, or wind down.
App blocking uses Apple Screen Time permission. Your sensitive Screen Time data stays protected by Apple and does not leave your device.
SEE WHAT TRULY CALMS YOU
Your Journey shows how you use ADHDFlow over time. Track listening by goal across the week, month, or past 3 months, and see which soundscapes you return to most for sleep, focus, calm, study, and work.
BUILT FOR DAILY ROUTINES
ADHDFlow includes a sleep and focus timer, fade-out support, background audio mode, stereo balance with Tune Tone, AirPlay support, goal-based recommendations, favorites, recent sounds, and personal listening insights.
A CALMER WAY TO FOCUS
ADHDFlow is not about forcing your brain to work harder. It is about giving it better conditions: steady sound, fewer distractions, and simple insight into what actually helps you feel calmer, sharper, and more in control.
DISCLAIMER
ADHDFlow is a wellness and relaxation app, not a medical device or treatment for ADHD, insomnia, anxiety, or any health condition. Results vary. If you have medical concerns, please consult a qualified professional.
SUBSCRIPTION
ADHDFlow offers monthly and yearly auto-renewing subscription options to get unlimited access to all content in the app. Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at the confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage and cancel your subscriptions by going to your account settings on the App Store after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
Privacy policy: https://bettersleeprise.com/privacy-policy

apple-macos:6786018687.name: Recito: Teleprompter for Video
apple-macos:6786018687.description:
Recito is a teleprompter app that records your video, on iPhone, iPad and Mac. Your script sits right under the lens, over the live camera, so you look into the camera, not down at your notes.
No account and no subscription: Recito Pro is a one-time purchase, and one purchase covers iPhone, iPad and Mac. No cloud: everything stays on your device.
THE TELEPROMPTER, DONE RIGHT
- The script sits high under the lens on a frosted, legible scrim — reading reads as eye contact.
- Adjust font size and scroll speed with a slider.
- Preview the scroll before you record to dial in your pace.
- Grab the text with your finger to scrub it mid-take.
- Mirror mode for beam-splitter teleprompter rigs.
ON IPAD TOO
- Full screen in landscape or portrait, or beside another app; readable at arm's length.
PAUSE WITHOUT LOSING THE TAKE
- Pause mid-script and the teleprompter freezes on the word you stopped at — carry on from exactly there.
- You still get ONE video. The pauses are invisible in the result.
- Fluffed a line? Delete just that part and record it again; the script rewinds with it.
RECORD AND REVIEW
- 3-2-1 countdown, then record like the stock Camera.
- Front or rear camera, portrait, with audio.
- Camera controls: tap to focus, hold for AE/AF lock, a level and a grid.
- Shoot several takes and play them back.
- A pace coach reads your delivery in words-per-minute — relaxed, great, or a touch fast.
- Keep the best take; it saves straight to Photos, ready for Reels, Shorts, or TikTok.
WORD-BY-WORD CAPTIONS (RECITO PRO)
- After a take, your script's words are timed to your own voice, on your device.
- Four styles. Auto finds your face and puts them under it when there's room; or choose top, middle or bottom.
- Lines Recito wasn't sure of are marked for you to check, and you can retype any line.
- Burned in when you save. iOS 26, in languages your device recognises on-device.
IT FOLLOWS YOUR VOICE
- Just read. The script keeps pace with you — speed up, slow down, pause to think, and the words stay where your eyes are.
- No speed to set and nothing to hold. Your hands stay free for the take.
- The word you are reading is marked, at the top of the band or in the middle, whichever you prefer.
- Recognition runs entirely on your device. Nothing is recorded, uploaded or kept — there is no account and no network involved.
- The language comes from the script itself, so there is nothing to choose. It works in the languages your device can already recognise; the app tells you plainly when yours is not one of them.
- Included free, on every script you can write for free. It starts off, so the script scrolls at the speed you set; turn it on with the Voice button when you want it.
REMOTES AND KEYBOARDS
- A Bluetooth camera remote, the volume buttons or Camera Control start and pause your take. Finish with the checkmark.
- Apple Watch (Recito Pro): start, pause and finish a take from your wrist. Finish asks first.
- With a keyboard, page turner or presentation clicker: Space starts and pauses; during a take, the arrow keys move the script.
YOUR SCRIPTS, IN ORDER
- Folders, and your own order: drag scripts where you want them, or keep the last edited on top.
- On iPad, folders and scripts sit in a sidebar beside the script you're writing, as in Notes.
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
- Recito collects nothing. The App Store privacy label reads "Data Not Collected."
- No analytics, no trackers, no network code outside Apple's StoreKit.
- Your scripts and videos never leave your device unless you save or share them.
ONE-TIME UNLOCK, NO SUBSCRIPTION
- Writing scripts, the teleprompter, voice-following, recording, and multiple takes are free.
- Recito Pro is a single one-time purchase: removes the watermark, allows unlimited-length scripts and adds captions and the Apple Watch remote.
- Restore it for free on any device on your Apple ID.
Questions? support@suprun.ca

apple-macos:6747931502.name: SimpleIPTV - IPTV & M3U Player
apple-macos:6747931502.description:
SimpleIPTV plays your own M3U playlists on iPhone and iPad. No account, no ads. You bring the playlist: the app does not sell or host any channels or content.
Highlights
• Add an Xtream Codes login next to your M3U playlists.
• Open playlists update by themselves, with progress, Cancel and Retry on screen.
• Download movies and episodes to watch offline.
• Casting starts from where you stopped.
• Pin your favorite groups to the top of the list.
• Redesigned movie and show screens, with the seasons in a rail.
Movies, shows and channels
• Posters, ratings, plot, cast and trailer links for movies and shows, from TMDB.
• Browse Channels, Movies and TV Shows separately.
• Filter movies and shows by genre, year and rating. Sort by name, recently added or rating.
• Shows open into seasons and episodes.
• Resume where you stopped. Episodes show progress and a watched mark, and the show button plays or resumes the next episode.
• Channels that come in several qualities (FHD, HD, SD) show as one row. Tap the row to pick a quality.
Playback that gets out of the way
• H.265/HEVC and other modern codecs play directly when the stream supports it, with automatic format conversion when it does not.
• Auto-retry recovers stalled streams without restarting the app.
• Picture in Picture.
• AirPlay to your TV and other AirPlay 2 receivers.
• Cast to Chromecast and Google TV from your iPhone or iPad. Casting keeps running through screen lock.
Playlists, organized
• Import from a URL or a file, or paste a link with one tap.
• Browse by group. Favorites and Recents have their own tabs, and search shows suggestions.
• Optional iCloud Sync keeps favorites, recents and watch progress in step across your devices. It stays off until you turn it on.
Accessibility
• Dynamic Type, Reduce Motion and VoiceOver labels.
Privacy
There is no account and no login. Your playlists are stored on your device. iCloud Sync is optional and uses your own iCloud account. The app does not track what you watch.
To show posters and details, SimpleIPTV sends movie and show titles from your playlist to its metadata service. Stream addresses are not sent. Turn off Enrich Movies and Shows in Settings to stop sending titles to the metadata service.
Movie and show information comes from TMDB. This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.
Made for
• Personal M3U setups and home media servers
• Self-hosted streams from NAS or local network sources
• Educational, corporate, and broadcaster-supplied playlists
• Developers testing M3U/M3U8 streams
Note: SimpleIPTV is a player. You bring your own M3U playlist URL or file. We do not sell or host any channels or content.
SimpleIPTV Premium
• 90 days free from first install.
• After the trial, a yearly subscription is needed to keep watching. It renews automatically at the App Store price unless canceled at least 24 hours before the period ends.
• Restore Purchases is available on the paywall and in Settings. Family Sharing is supported.

fdroid:io.payanam.name: Payanam
fdroid:io.payanam.summary: Navigate your life journey across dimensions privately
fdroid:io.payanam.description:
Payanam (பயணம் — "journey") is a privacy-first life dimension manager for Android. Track what matters to you across the dimensions of life you define.
 Your data stays on your device by default. You control what leaves it. No cloud of ours. No accounts. No tracking. No subscriptions. Payanam has no servers of its own.
 Life Dimensions 
Comes with 9 default dimensions — Work & Livelihood, Physical Health, Family & Relationships, Home Environment, Money & Finance, Mental Health, Recreation & Leisure, Learning & Growth, Community & Service. Customize names, icons, colors, or create your own. Set per-dimension weightage that controls how each life area contributes to your scores.
 Habits — The Core 
The most mature module. Habits are recurring tasks with frequency-aware scheduling (daily, weekly, or X times per Y days). Every completion cascades through a 3-level metric system — habit-level (score, streaks, progress) → dimension-level (weighted average with carry-forward) → day-level aggregate. Dedicated habits insights include a score matrix (6 metrics, 14-day sparklines, rankings) and a dimension-spread radar chart comparing today's scores against your running average.
 Tasks 
Full CRUD with a 6-factor priority scoring engine (dimension importance, impact, goal alignment, energy, control, duration) — all configurable weights. Set due dates, tags, reminders, recurrence, and track occurrence history. Stopping time tracking auto-completes the linked task.
 Time Tracking 
Per-dimension time blocks with focus rating (0.0–1.0). Manual sessions: pick a dimension, start, stop. Habit auto-track: completing a habit auto-creates a time entry (opt-in per dimension, 15-min default). Both paths write to the same time store — there's no separate "habit time" vs "task time." Day-plan allocations let you set planned minutes per dimension; a Gaussian model scores how well actual time matches your plan.
 Journal 
Two levels per day: overall day reflection + per-dimension prompts. Both independently fillable each day.
 Insights & Lenses 
Opt-in by design — pick and enable exactly which charts you want (score cards, trends, heatmaps, radar, splits, timelines). Lenses build planning-vs-reality snapshots from time entries, task occurrences, and day-plan allocations. Five reflection card types detect untracked time, missed tasks, missed habits, focus gaps, and dimension gaps. Some chart metrics are still evolving — marked as pending in-app.
 Day Planning 
Template-based with auto/custom modes. Set planned minutes per dimension, with weekday/weekend preferences. Feeds time-deviation scoring and Lenses.
 Scoring Configuration 
Fine-grained control: adjust 6 cross-task factor weights plus per-level values for impact, goal alignment, energy, and control. Your priorities, your formula.
 Security & Backup 
Encrypted by default — set a strong passphrase (12+ chars, upper/lower/digit/symbol) on first launch. Optional biometric unlock with configurable auto-lock timeout (1 min to 4 hours). Auto-backup on configurable intervals (15 min to 24 hours) with rotation. Manual encrypted export/import with passphrase. Export logs from settings or the unlock screen.
 Customization 
Enable or disable individual modules. Choose your default home tab. System theme with Material You dynamic colors. English and Tamil locale support. Font family customization (sans, serif, monospace, cursive).
 Cross-Platform & Updates 
Android is in good shape. Windows desktop in early development. Linux and other platforms planned. Goal: fully featured cross-platform apps with same data, features, and privacy. GitHub builds include an in-app update checker (dev/beta/stable, opt-in). The F-Droid build has no in-app updates — update through your F-Droid client. For in-app updates, install from GitHub releases.
Payanam is open source under AGPL-3.0.
No ads. No analytics. No dark patterns. Just your journey.
